title: Remote Meta/Facebook & TikTok Media Buyer / Social Media Manager
description:
REMOTE META & TIKTOK MEDIA BUYER / SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGER



We are hiring a Remote Meta & TikTok Media Buyer / Social Media Manager to manage paid advertising campaigns and social media growth for U.S.-based businesses.



This role combines both media buying and social media management. We are looking for someone creative, analytical, organized, and experienced in running ads while also managing and growing social media accounts.



We are specifically looking for candidates with:



* Experience running Meta Ads 
 & Instagram) and TikTok Ads

* Understanding of lead generation and conversion campaigns

* Experience creating and managing social media content

* Ability to analyze ad performance and optimize campaigns

* Understanding of trends, hooks, and short-form content

* Strong communication and reporting skills

* Reliable internet and ability to work independently



Responsibilities:



* Launch and manage
, Instagram, and TikTok ad campaigns

* Monitor ad performance and optimize campaigns for better results

* Create audiences, retargeting campaigns, and lookalike audiences

* Manage social media accounts and posting schedules

* Create captions, content ideas, and assist with creative direction

* Coordinate with video editors/designers for ad creatives and reels

* Track KPIs such as CPL, CTR, ROAS, and conversions

* Research trends and viral content ideas

* Help grow engagement, followers, and lead generation

* Provide weekly performance reports



Preferred Experience:



* Experience working with U.S.-based businesses

* Experience with service business lead generation

* Familiarity with Meta Business Suite, TikTok Ads Manager, Canva, CapCut, or Adobe tools

* Understanding of funnels, landing pages, and conversion tracking

* Familiarity with CRMs and GoHighLevel is a plus

* Experience with AI tools is a plus



Position Details:



* Remote Position

* Starts Part-Time

* Opportunity to grow into Full-Time based on performance

* Flexible working hours



To Apply, Please Submit:



* Short video introduction. Say "Accept who you are. Unless you’re a serial killer." As your opening sentence

* Resume

* Portfolio or examples of social media accounts and ad campaigns you’ve managed

* Screenshots or case studies of ad performance

* Explain one campaign you improved and how

* Your available working hours and timezone



Compensation:

Starting pay at $5/hr. Performance bonuses available.

title: Full-time IT/Operations/GHL Manager
description:
IT & Systems Manager

Full Time | 40 Hours per Week | Compensation Based on Experience



About the Role

We are looking for a resourceful, technically capable, and proactive IT & Systems Manager to build, configure, maintain, troubleshoot, and improve systems across multiple businesses and projects.

This is a hands-on role covering GoHighLevel and similar platforms, websites and pages, accounts and sub-accounts, forms, calendars,
, workflows, custom fields, webhooks, integrations, automations, communities, funnels, video editing, presentations, and other technical systems as needed.

You do not need to be an expert in every area. We care most about technical aptitude, ownership, independent problem-solving, attention to detail, user experience, and the ability to learn quickly.

Your main responsibility is simple: make sure our technical systems and assets work correctly and create a good experience for the people using them.



Responsibilities

You may be responsible for:

Building, configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting technical systems across multiple businesses, communities, creators, campaigns, and projects.

Creating and updating websites, landing pages, funnels, community pages, and other digital assets, including content, forms, calendars, links, images, and related components.

Configuring GoHighLevel and similar platforms, including accounts and sub-accounts,
, custom fields, workflows, pipelines, forms, calendars, domains, permissions, webhooks, integrations, and automations.

Making sure pages, forms, calendars,
, automations, domains, accounts, and other components are connected to the correct systems and configured properly.

Testing complete user flows and identifying broken links, incorrect configurations, missing steps, poor mobile experiences, or other problems before users encounter them.

Connecting systems through native integrations, Zapier, Make, APIs, webhooks, and similar tools.

Creating, editing, and correcting videos when needed, including presentation videos, intros, effects, animations, transitions, audio, screen recordings, and basic production work.

Preparing and testing technical systems and assets for launches, campaigns, webinars, communities, creators, presentations, and other initiatives.

Maintaining organized accounts, access, naming conventions, documentation, templates, and basic SOPs.



How We Work

Take ownership of your work through completion. Communicate progress without waiting to be asked, raise meaningful issues early, test your own work, and proactively identify and address problems rather than waiting for every task to be assigned.

Independent thinking and resourcefulness are essential. When you encounter something you do not know, use AI extensively to research, diagnose, and solve the problem. Also use documentation, tutorials, knowledge bases, internet research, community resources, and software-company support. If specialized help is ultimately required, identify the right resource while continuing to own the issue through resolution.

When disagreeing, do it productively. Proactively investigate before challenging, while escalating immediately if even reasonable investigation could create material harm or serious risk. Otherwise, make reasonable progress and validate concerns with facts before raising them. When raising a concern, bring what you learned and, whenever possible, a recommended solution, practical options, or clear next step.

Be settled, connected, and ready before meetings. Follow through on commitments, communicate when something is delayed or blocked, and correct mistakes quickly when they happen.

Think from the user's perspective. Technical correctness matters, but so do clarity, usability, consistency, and the complete experience of the person using what you build.

We do not expect perfection or that you will know everything. We do expect independent problem-solving, proactive action, communication, accountability, and follow-through.



What We're Looking For

You should have:

Strong written English and communication skills.

Reliable internet and the ability to work consistently and independently.

Strong attention to detail, organization, and technical aptitude.

The ability to encounter unfamiliar technical problems and independently work toward solutions.

A genuine passion for technology and especially AI.

A habit of staying current with new AI tools, capabilities, and trends, particularly how AI is changing technology, marketing, and business.

Natural curiosity about new tools and the ability to identify practical ways they can improve systems, automation, marketing, content, and user experience.

Experience with some of the following is helpful, but you do not need to know everything:

GoHighLevel, Votel, WordPress, websites and funnels, CRM systems, forms and calendars,
 configuration, workflows, custom fields, APIs, webhooks, Zapier, Make, domains and DNS, integrations, communities, marketing automation, CapCut, Descript, DaVinci Resolve, Canva, Adobe Premiere, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and similar platforms.

Do not skip applying because you do not check every box. We would rather hire someone capable, dependable, curious, and resourceful who knows how to figure things out than someone who claims to know everything.



What Success Looks Like

When you are assigned something, you think beyond the individual task and consider the complete system and user experience.

If you build a page, for example, you make sure it is in the correct account, contains the right content, has working links, connects to the correct form or calendar, sends information where it should go, works on desktop and mobile, makes sense to the user, and has been tested before you call it complete.

When you encounter something unfamiliar, you research it, use AI and available support resources, test potential solutions, and keep moving. You look ahead for problems and opportunities rather than waiting for someone else to identify every next step.

Working Relationship

This is intended to be a long-term working relationship for the right person. We hire on a month-to-month basis, with the expectation that the first month gives both parties an opportunity to establish a strong working rhythm and determine whether continuing together makes sense.

We are looking for someone who wants to become a reliable, long-term part of the team, not someone looking for a short-term project or a few days of work.

This is a freelance/independent contractor role. Continued work depends on performance, reliability, communication, business needs, and mutual fit.



To Apply

Please include:

A short introduction about yourself.

Your relevant technical and systems experience.

Your experience with GoHighLevel or similar platforms.

Examples of websites, funnels, automations, integrations, or other systems you have personally built or managed.

Your video editing and production experience, if any.

The AI tools you currently use and how you use them to solve technical problems.

An example of a new AI tool, capability, or trend you have recently explored and why you found it useful.

Your availability, timezone, and internet speed.

Why you are interested in a long-term role like this.

Scenario: You are asked to implement something and initially believe there may be a technical problem with the requested approach. It does not appear to create an immediate serious risk. Walk us through what you would do before raising the concern, and how you would communicate it if your investigation confirms there is a better approach.

Please start your application with the words:

IT READY

title: Direct Response Video Editor for Meta Ads for Medical Clinics (Batch Editing)
description:
Read this whole post before applying. The instructions at the bottom are part

of the test.



WHO WE ARE



Novaris Global. We run paid advertising for private medical clinics, mostly

plastic surgery and aesthetics. Our clients are in Singapore and we are

expanding. Our ads run on Meta. When they work, the clinic books consultations.

When they don't, we lose money. That is the entire scoreboard.



THE MAIN THING YOU WOULD BE DOING



Once or twice a month a doctor sits down and records for 30 to 60 minutes

straight. He works through a stack of scripts, flubs lines, restarts, goes off

on tangents, repeats himself, and says something better on the third take than

he did on the first.



Nobody slates the takes. Nobody marks where one ad ends. It is one long messy

file.



Out of that single file we need 30 to 60 finished Meta video ads.



Not 30 exports of the same cut. Thirty to sixty ads that each open differently,

run differently, and feel like they came from different creatives. That is how

Meta finds a winner, and it is the actual skill we are hiring for.



That means you:



- Watch the whole file and map what is really in there

- D
 where one ad ends and the next one starts

- Pick the strongest take of every line, not the first one

- Cut the sentences that add nothing. Warm ups, throat clearing, repeated

  ideas, and the line that is technically true but kills the pace

- Reorder freely. If the best hook is something he said at minute 34, that line

  goes to second zero

- Recombine. The same three sentences in a different order, with a different

  opening line and a different first ten seconds, is a different ad

- Build each one properly. On screen text in the first two seconds, burned in

  captions throughout, a lower third with his name and clinic, b-roll, sound

  design, graphics, end card



THE OTHER TWO KINDS OF WORK



Not everything arrives as a batch. Some weeks you get a single clip and a brief

and we need one sharp ad out of it by tomorrow.



And some weeks you get a video sales letter. Long form, five to twenty minutes,

a doctor walking through an argument end to end. Completely different edit. The

hook still has to land in the first few seconds, but now you are holding

attention for fifteen minutes instead of thirty seconds, which means pacing,

chapter beats, visual variety, and knowing exactly where a viewer gets bored

and what to put there. If you have never cut long form, say so honestly. If you

have, lead with it.



EVERY AD HAS TO FEEL DIFFERENT



This is the part almost every editor fails.



When you cut 40 ads from one recording, the lazy version is one template with

40 different hooks dropped in. Meta sees through it, the audience sees through

it, and the account stalls.



We want visible variety across the set. Different caption styles. Different

graphic treatments. One ad that leans on text animation, one that is almost

bare and lets him talk, one built around a simple diagram, one with heavier

b-roll, one that opens on a graphic before he appears. Different rhythms.

Different energy.



Someone scrolling should never think they have already seen this ad. Play

around. Have opinions. Show us range.



THE LINE YOU CANNOT CROSS WHILE DOING IT



This is a surgeon, not a dropshipper. Every one of those 40 ads still has to

look expensive, clean, and calm. Variety in style, never variety in standards.



No meme zooms. No shake. No cartoon sound effects. No AI voice. No stock

footage of a family smiling at sunset. If an edit would look at home selling a

phone case, it is wrong for us.



The hard version of this job is doing both at once. Retention editing that

actually holds attention, inside a look a private surgeon would put his name

on. Most editors can do one or the other.



Medical advertising in Singapore is also regulated, and moves that are normal

everywhere else are illegal there. No before and after footage. No testimonials.

No "best" or "guaranteed." No countdowns or scarcity. We give you the full rule

sheet on day one, but you have to be someone who follows a rule sheet exactly,

every time, without being reminded.



WHAT YOU NEED TO ALREADY KNOW



- Hook rate and hold rate, and what actually moves them. If your answer to a

  weak hook is "add a zoom," this role is not for you

- The first two seconds carry on screen text, because most of Meta watches on

  mute

- A retention beat every few seconds. A cut, a caption change, a graphic, a

  b-roll insert. Something has to change or they are gone

- Captions readable at arm's length on a phone, inside Meta's safe zones, not

  sitting under the interface

- Sound design that supports the point instead of decorating it. A whoosh on

  every cut is amateur work

- 9:16 at 1080x1920, correct loudness, correct export settings, and a first

  frame that is not a blink

- Written English strong enough to judge a sentence. You are d
 which of

  a surgeon's sentences survive. That takes real comprehension, not just an ear

  for rhythm



NICE TO HAVE, NOT REQUIRED



If you can write, say so. If you can watch a raw recording and tell us "he

never said the thing that would make this ad work, here is what he should say

next time," that is worth more to us than another year of Premiere experience,

and it changes what we pay you.



THE SETUP



- Full time, 40 hours a week

- Your own machine that handles 4K without taking an hour to export

- Reliable internet, because you are moving large files

- Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci, CapCut, whatever you like. We care about

  the output, not your toolkit

- You work directly with me. Small team, no layers, fast decisions



HOW THIS STARTS



A paid trial. Real footage, a real brief, real money for your time.



We are not going to pretend a reel tells us anything. Plenty of great reels

were cut by somebody else. The trial tells us what you actually do when a messy

file lands in your lap.



If the work comes back genuinely excellent, and we mean excellent and not

acceptable, we move straight to a full time offer. If it does not, you keep the

money and we part on good terms.



BEFORE YOU D
 THIS IS TOO MUCH WORK



Yes, this application asks more of you than the other posts on this site. That

is deliberate. So here is the honest math on what you are applying to.



We are hiring one person, once. Whoever we pick stops applying for jobs.



You are not applying to a task. You are applying to a department that does not

exist yet, with your name on it. Right now every video for every client we have

runs through one folder and one to do list. The person we hire builds what

replaces that. You set the standard. You make the templates every editor after

you works from. You hire those editors and review their work instead of doing

it. Head of Video, across every account, fully in house. Not a freelancer we

message when something comes up. On the team, in the meetings, in the decisions.



You will also see the money side, which almost no editor anywhere gets to see.

Hook rate on your cuts. Cost per lead. Which clinic booked how many

consultations off which edit. That feedback loop is the entire difference

between an editor who is good at software and an editor who is worth whatever

they ask for, for the rest of their career. We will hand it to you.



And here is why we can pay for that. Our clients do not pay us a flat fee. We

take a share of the revenue we generate for them. When your ad wins, we do not

save money, we make more of it. So we would far rather pay one exceptional

editor well beyond what this platform normally pays than hire five cheap ones

and manage them. Your ceiling here is not an hourly rate. It grows with the

accounts you are cutting for.



A few hours today. If we are right about each other, you will look back on this

as the best few hours you ever spent on an application.



If none of that moves you, please do not apply. We would rather read ten

serious applications than a hundred lazy ones.



HOW TO APPLY



Do all four. Applications missing any of them get deleted unread.



Two of these are what we actually judge: the ads you have already cut, and what

you cut for us. The other two take a minute each. Spend your time on the first

two.



1. Make THUMBSTOP the first word of your message.



2. Send three to five direct response video ads you personally cut.



   What counts: ads that actually ran as paid media on Meta, TikTok, or

   YouTube. Something built to make a stranger take an action.



   What does not count and will get your application closed: showreels,

   montages, wedding films, YouTube intros, vlogs, corporate brand videos,

   event recaps, anything cut to music with no message.



   Do not send a reel. Send the ads themselves, full length, exactly as they

   ran. We watch from the first frame, because the first frame is the job.



   For each one, one line covering:

   - Who it was for and what it was selling

   - Whether it ran as paid media, and roughly what it spent if you know

   - Any numbers you have. Hook rate, hold rate, CTR, cost per result. If you

     have none, say none. We would rather hear that than a guess

   - What you personally did on it, honestly. If you cut it start to finish,

     say so. If you did captions and graphics on somebody else's assembly, say

     that instead. We will find out either way, and the honest answer has never

     cost anyone the job



   If your strongest work is under an NDA, send what you can and tell us what

   we are missing.



3. Cut something from this file:



   



   THE MINIMUM is five seconds. Just the hook. The opening that would stop

   someone scrolling, with whatever on screen text, sound, graphics, and

   cutting you think earns those five seconds. Start from any moment in the

   file you want. A genuinely strong five seconds is enough to get you

   shortlisted.



   THE FULL AD IS BETTER. If you send a finished ad cut from this file, hook

   through to end card with captions all the way, we will watch every second of

   it and you go to the top of the pile. It is not required. It is an

   opportunity, and the people who take it are usually the people we hire.



   Either way, in two or three sentences: why that moment, why that treatment,

   and what you cut out and why.



   Do not post this footage anywhere public.



4. Answer this in writing. You receive a 45 minute file of a surgeon recording

   what he thinks are eight ads. He goes off script constantly and the single

   best line he says is at minute 38. What do you do in your first hour, before

   you cut anything? And how do you get 40 genuinely different ads out of it

   instead of 40 versions of one?



Shortlisted applicants go straight to a paid trial on real client footage.

title: Business Development & Proposal Coordinator
description:
Engagement Type: Independent Contractor | Remote



We are seeking an experienced, highly organized, and resourceful independent contractor to provide Business Development & Proposal Coordination services. This engagement will focus heavily on identifying bid and contracting opportunities, preparing and submitting proposals, researching industry opportunities, generating prospective client leads, and maintaining our sales pipeline and CRM. The contractor must maintain substantial availability during our operational hours to support time-sensitive solicitations, communications, meetings, and submission deadlines, while independently managing the manner and method used to complete assigned deliverables.



Key Responsibilities

Monitor approximately 20–25 procurement, bid, and solicitation platforms for relevant RFPs, RFQs, IFBs, subcontracting opportunities, and other solicitations.



Conduct additional research to identify opportunities that may not appear on our standard bid platforms, including prime contractor and subcontracting opportunities.



Review solicitations to determine basic eligibility, scope, deadlines, requirements, and potential fit.



Maintain a centralized bid and opportunity tracker, including due dates, pre-bid meetings, questions deadlines, addenda, submission requirements, and status.



Prepare and complete RFP/RFQ/bid responses, including assembling company information, qualifications, certifications, forms, resumes, project experience, and supporting documentation.



Manage bid and proposal deadlines from preparation through final submission, ensuring all bids are accurate, complete, and submitted on time. Timely bid preparation and submission is a critical responsibility of this position.



Research upcoming industry conferences, conventions, seminars, networking events, procurement events, outreach events, and other business-development opportunities relevant to the company's markets and services.



Identify potential clients, prime contractors, subcontractors, developers, agencies, and strategic partners for business-development outreach.



Conduct lead generation and prospect research.



Maintain the company's CRM and sales pipeline, documenting prospects, contacts, outreach, follow-ups, opportunities, next steps, and outcomes.



Manage follow-up schedules so prospective clients and opportunities do not fall through the cracks.



Respond to inbound sales leads and inquiries and route opportunities appropriately.



Assist with outbound
 and other business-development outreach.



Maintain organized records of proposals, solicitations, leads, contacts, and business-development activities.



Provide regular reports and deliverables on active bids, upcoming opportunities, leads, proposal status, and sales-pipeline activity.



Qualifications

Strong online research and analytical skills.



Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.



Strong command of the English language, including written and verbal communication.



Ability to manage numerous deadlines and opportunities simultaneously.



Must have experience with RFPs, RFQs, procurement, proposal coordination, business development, lead generation, or sales support.



Must have experience using CRM and sales pipeline management systems.



Comfortable researching government agencies, contractors, construction companies, and procurement websites.



Must have advanced-level Microsoft Excel skills.



Must be able to perform services independently and proactively identify and complete required deliverables rather than waiting for day-to-day direction.



Must be self-starting, self-motivated, and capable of independently determining the manner and method used to complete the work and achieve required results while using required company systems, CRM platforms, bid templates, Excel tracking sheets, and other designated tools and documentation.



Must be punctual, dependable, and highly deadline-driven for agreed meetings, communications, and submission requirements. The ability to prepare and submit bids within required timeframes is essential.



Must maintain substantial availability during the company's operational hours when necessary for bid deadlines, scheduled meetings, client or agency communications, and other time-sensitive deliverables.



Must demonstrate a high level of discretion and the ability to maintain strict confidentiality regarding company, client, proposal, and business-development information.



Must be willing to enter into an Independent Contractor Agreement and sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) as a condition of engagement.



Engagement is subject to completion of a background check and any required authorization for the processing of personal information.



Preferred Experience

Experience in one or more of the following is highly desirable:



Construction | Public Works | Government Contracting | Labor Compliance | Prevailing Wage | Federal Contracting | Renewable Energy | Infrastructure | Professional Services | Government Procurement



What Success Looks Like

The right person will create an organized and consistent business-development process. Bid platforms are monitored routinely, qualified opportunities are identified early, proposal deadlines are tracked, submissions are organized, industry events are researched, leads are followed up on, and the CRM accurately reflects where every prospective client and opportunity stands.



This position requires someone who is proactive, persistent, organized, research-oriented, and deadline-driven. We are looking for someone who actively searches for the next opportunity and makes sure potential business is followed through from identification to submission or sales follow-up.

title: VIRTUAL MEDICAL ASSITANT
description:
VIRTUAL MEDICAL ASSISTANT

 Internal Medicine Clinic, P.A.

Remote Position | U.S. Central Time (CST/CDT)

 Internal Medicine Clinic is seeking a dependable, organized, and experienced Virtual Medical Assistant to provide remote administrative support to our clinical team and patients.

We are looking for someone interested in a stable, long-term professional working relationship. The ideal candidate is reliable, detail-oriented, comfortable communicating with patients and healthcare organizations, and able to follow established procedures while becoming increasingly independent after training.

RESPONSIBILITIES

The Virtual Medical Assistant may be responsible for:

• Answering and managing patient telephone calls

• Scheduling, confirming, and rescheduling patient appointments

• Managing patient referrals

• Processing and following up on prior authorizations

• Following up with insurance companies regarding outstanding matters

• Following up on incomplete, pending, or outstanding work

• Maintaining accurate and timely documentation

• Following written clinic policies, procedures, and workflows

• Performing other medical-office duties as assigned

Ideal candidates should have:

• Previous experience as a Virtual Medical Assistant, Medical Assistant, Medical VA, or healthcare administrative assistant

title: AutoCad Designer
description:
We are seeking a skilled AutoCAD Designer with specialized experience in water engineering and fitting development.



In this role, you will bridge the gap between initial concept and production. You will work directly with our engineering team to translate complex ideas, rough sketches, and functional requirements into precise 2D and 3D manufacturing models. The ideal candidate has deep expertise in standard flange configurations, pressure ratings, and designing components suitable for moulding, casting, and precision machining.



Key Responsibilities

Concept to Model: Translate napkin sketches, verbal concepts, and functional specs into detailed, manufacturable AutoCAD models and production drawings.



Component Design: Design a wide array of water fittings, flanges, compression seals, adapters, and custom inline components.



Manufacturing Readiness: Prepare production-ready files tailored for injection moulding, sand/investment casting, or CNC machining—accounting for draft angles, wall thicknesses, and tolerances.



Standards & Compliance: Ensure all CAD designs comply with relevant water industry standards, pressure classes, bolt patterns, and flange specifications (e.g., ANSI/ASME, DIN, or local water authority specs).



Design Iteration: Collaborate closely with engineers and product managers to refine designs based on prototype testing and manufacturing feedback.



Documentation: Maintain accurate BOMs (Bills of Materials), revision histories, and technical specification sheets.



Qualifications & Requirements

Software Expertise: Mastery of AutoCAD (2D drafting & 3D modeling); proficiency in SolidWorks or Autodesk Inventor is a strong plus.



Domain Knowledge: Proven background in water engineering, industrial piping, pressure systems, and fluid management.



Flange & Fitting Design: Strong working knowledge of flange standards, gasket seats, mechanical joint profiles, and pressure-retaining fittings.



Manufacturing Processes: Solid understanding of how components are manufactured, specifically moulding, casting, and machining, to ensure designs are optimized for production.



Technical Communication: Ability to visualize abstract engineering concepts and ask the right questions to extract key requirements.



Detail-Oriented: Exceptional spatial awareness and accuracy in dimensioning, geometric tolerancing (GD&T), and material selection.

description:
Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller

Location: Remote Employment Type: Full-Time 

Experience Required: 1–2 Years



Turn Your Voice Into Your Biggest Asset



Are you the person who can get a "no" and still walk away with a callback? Do you thrive on the thrill of a great pitch and love closing the gap between a cold lead and a booked appointment? We're looking for a Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller who's ready to bring energy, persistence, and persuasion to a growing, fast-paced commercial real estate team.

This isn't just dialing numbers — it's the front line of our acquisitions pipeline for commercial properties, including office, retail, industrial, multifamily (5+ units), and mixed-use assets. Every call you make has the potential to turn into a deal, and every deal you help set up is a direct reflection of your skill on the phone. Commercial deals move differently than residential — longer relationships, bigger stakes, and owners or decision-makers who expect a caller who sounds like they know the space.

If you're confident, quick on your feet, and genuinely enjoy the game of turning "not interested" into "let's talk," we want to hear from you.



What You'll Do



Make outbound cold calls to commercial property owners, landlords, investors, asset managers, and brokers across asset classes (office, retail, industrial, multifamily, mixed-use)

Pull and build targeted call lists using county records, CRE data platforms, and public/private property databases

Identify and qualify off-market and undervalued commercial properties based on owner motivation, property condition, and financial indicators

Gather key property details: lease type (NNN, gross, modified gross), tenant occupancy/vacancy status, square footage, zoning, and ownership structure

Research and reach decision-makers directly — including owners, property managers, LLC representatives, and asset managers — not just front-desk contacts

Set qualified appointments for our acquisitions/sales team with clear notes on deal potential

Maintain and update CRM with detailed call notes, property data, and lead status

Follow call scripts while keeping conversations natural, credible, and tailored to commercial owners

Hit daily/weekly call volume, talk-time, and lead generation targets

Handle objections with confidence — especially from sophisticated owners, brokers, and gatekeepers who are used to fielding investor calls



What You Bring



1–2 years of experience in a call center handling international accounts, and/or real estate cold calling — commercial experience strongly preferred

Excellent English communication skills (neutral accent preferred)

Comfort speaking with business owners, investors, and brokers — not just residential homeowners

Strong persuasion and negotiation instincts — you know how to read a conversation and steer it

Ability to work independently and stay motivated with minimal supervision

Comfort with high-volume outbound calling and skip tracing/contact research

Experience pulling and building your own lead lists (county records, CRE data platforms, or similar tools)

A target-driven mindset and genuine competitive streak

Familiarity with CRM systems (a plus, not a must)



Bonus Points For



Working knowledge of commercial real estate terminology: cap rate, NOI, NNN/gross leases, cash-on-cash return, CRE asset classes

Experience cold calling for office, retail, industrial, or multifamily acquisitions specifically

Experience with lead generation tools, skip tracing platforms, and auto-dialers

Familiarity with list-pulling/data platforms such as PropStream, Reonomy, CoStar, or county assessor records

Prior appointment-setting experience for acquisitions or investment sales teams

Sharp listening skills and objection-handling instincts with sophisticated, high-value prospects



Why You'll Want This Role



Competitive base salary — get rewarded for showing up and doing the work

Real growth opportunities — this is a growing company, and top performers won't go unnoticed

A supportive, performance-driven team — we win together, and we celebrate wins

title: Static Ad Designer for Meta Ads (Lead Gen, Not E-commerce)
description:
We are a marketing agency running Meta ads for private medical clinics in Singapore. We are hiring one designer to create static image ads for
 and Instagram.



This is a performance role, not a branding role. Your ads get judged on whether they produce booked appointments, and you will see the numbers every week.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Design 15 to 25 unique static ads per week (4:5 and 9:16), from a written brief

- Turn a strategy angle into an ad: headline, layout, hierarchy, visual idea

- Build each ad as a genuinely different idea, not one layout recoloured five times

- Work inside strict rules: no before-and-after photos, no patient testimonials, no "best" or "guaranteed" claims. Singapore medical advertising law forbids them

- Write two or three sentences on every ad explaining the idea and who it is for

- Iterate on winners when an ad performs, instead of always starting from zero



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



- Real experience designing static ads for LEAD GENERATION businesses (clinics, coaching, home services, finance, legal, B2B). E-commerce-only portfolios will not be considered. This is the most important requirement

- Speed with quality. We need volume and variety, every week

- Understanding of how Meta actually works: why 4:5 for feed, why Advantage+ auto-crop wrecks a layout, why an ad has to read in half a second on a muted phone screen at thumbnail size

- Enough creative strategy sense to understand WHY an angle exists and who it is aimed at. You do not need to run ads or buy media. We handle that

- Figma, Photoshop, or Canva. Send us your source files

- Good written English



NICE TO HAVE



- Aesthetics, healthcare, or any regulated industry experience

- Experience producing ads at volume for an agency



HOW TO APPLY



Please answer these in your application. We read them carefully and we will ignore applications that skip them.



1. Send your portfolio. Include at least three static ads you made for a lead generation client, not e-commerce

2. Show us ONE ad that performed well and ONE that failed, from the same account. Tell us why you think the second one lost

3. How many unique static concepts did you produce per week in your last role?

4. How would you sell a $14,000 surgery with no before-and-after photos, no testimonials, no reviews, and no discount? Two or three sentences

5. Start your application with the word ORCHARD so we know you read this



Shortlisted applicants get a small paid test: six static ads in 48 hours, with a short note on each. We pay for the test whether or not we hire you.

OPERATIONS MANAGER – INCUBATION



Department Focus

New Client Stabilization & Successful Transition

The Incubation Department manages new clients during their first 90 days.

The Operations Manager for Incubation is responsible for ensuring that Virtual Assistants are successfully

onboarded, stabilized, and positioned for long-term retention before transitioning to SMB or Enterprise.



Primary Objective

Build a repeatable and effective operating model that helps new clients achieve early success, establishes

strong CSM-VA relationships, and identifies risks before they become client or VA separations.



Key Responsibilities: 



Operational Excellence

● Identify operational gaps within the first-90-day client lifecycle.

● Establish clear standards for what a successful Incubation account looks like.

● Identify recurring onboarding, communication, deployment, and client-management issues.

● Ensure handoffs between Sales, Deployment, Incubation, and other teams are clearly defined.

Process & Workflow

● Build and continuously improve the Incubation CSM workflow.

● Standardize onboarding, client check-ins, escalation, VA performance monitoring, and transition

processes.

● Ensure CSMs follow required SOPs and workflows.

● Identify opportunities to automate or simplify repetitive processes.

Early Client & VA Success

● Establish early-warning indicators for clients and VAs.

● Ensure CSMs proactively address dissatisfaction, performance concerns, misalignment, and other early

risks.

● Improve the speed and quality of issue resolution.

● Identify patterns that contribute to early client or VA pullouts.

CSM Effectiveness

● Define what effective Incubation CSM performance looks like.

● Monitor whether CSMs are proactively managing accounts rather than reacting to problems.

● Identify CSM capability gaps and recommend coaching or process interventions.



KPIs & Quality

Develop and monitor Incubation-specific KPIs focused on outcomes such as:

● Early Client Retention

● First-90-Day Client Health

● VA Retention / Replacement Rate

● Client Satisfaction

● Time to Resolution

● Successful Client Transition Rate

● Process/SOP Compliance



Scalability Mandate



Build a standardized 90-day client operating model that can support increasing numbers of new clients

without requiring proportional increases in management effort.



What Success Looks Like



The Incubation OM succeeds when:

● New clients are properly onboarded and stabilized.

● Risks are identified early.

● CSMs consistently follow the Incubation operating model.

● Early client and VA issues are resolved before they become separations.

● Clients transition to the next department successfully.

● The Incubation process becomes increasingly standardized, measurable, and scalable.



Benefits of Joining Our Team: 

1. ???? Competitive Compensation: Earn a salary rate of USD per hour for a full-time commitment of 40 hours per week. We believe in recognizing and valuing your contributions, ensuring you’re rewarded for your hard work. 

2. ???? Thriving Towards Milestone Bonus: Build a secure future with our milestone bonus, ensuring you’re well-prepared to embark on your next chapter when the time comes. $750 with 1 full vesting year with Legal Soft. 

3. ???? Health Guardian: Your well-being is our top priority. Enjoy comprehensive health insurance coverage, providing you with peace of mind and access to top-notch medical care in your country*. 

4. ???? Supercharged Wi-Fi Connectivity: Stay connected and productive with a $25 monthly subsidy towards your home Wi-Fi. Power through your tasks with lightning speed and efficiency. 

5. ✈️ Unleash Your Wanderlust: Take advantage of our generous paid time off (PTO) and paid sick leave policies. Whether it’s exploring new destinations or taking a well-deserved break, we’ve got you covered, ensuring you can recharge and return refreshed. 

Experience the thrill of being acknowledged with special rewards and heartfelt gratitude for your dedication. 



****Please do not apply if you expected hourly rate is beyond $9. Thank you!****

title: Warhammer 40K Scriptwriter Needed | Lore-Focused YouTube Channel
description:
Warhammer 40K YouTube Scriptwriter | Long-Term Opportunity



We are looking for a reliable and skilled scriptwriter to create engaging, long-form Warhammer 40K lore scripts for our YouTube channel.



RESPONSIBILITIES



* Write 4,000–10,000-word Warhammer 40K scripts.

* Research and fact-check Warhammer 40K lore accurately.

* Create strong introductions, smooth transitions, and narrative-driven scripts.

* Read and proofread long scripts carefully before submission.

* Rewrite obvious AI-generated, vague, repetitive, or unnatural sections.

* Complete revisions based on feedback.

* Deliver at least one script per week.

* Communicate consistently regarding progress, questions, and possible delays.



REQUIREMENTS



* Previous long-form YouTube scriptwriting experience.

* Strong English writing and proofreading skills.

* Strong research and source-checking abilities.

* Experience writing documentary, gaming, history, or lore content.

* Good knowledge of Warhammer 40K, or strong experience researching fictional universes.

* Ability to humanize and improve AI-assisted writing.

* Ability to meet deadlines and apply feedback throughout the entire script.

* Reliable and consistent communication.

* Comfortable reading and proofreading scripts that are 7+ pages long.



IMPORTANT: This role requires regularly reading and proofreading long pieces of content. If you are not comfortable reading or reviewing scripts that are seven pages or longer, this position may not be a good fit for you.



TO APPLY



Please send the following:



1. A short introduction.

2. Your years of scriptwriting experience.

3. Samples of 20–40-minute documentary, gaming, history, or lore scripts.

4. Relevant Warhammer 40K samples, if available.

5. Your experience researching fictional universes.

6. Your weekly availability.

7. Confirmation that you can deliver at least one script per week and communicate consistently.



Rate: To be discussed.



We are looking for someone interested in a long-term working relationship. Please apply only if you meet the requirements and are comfortable with the expected workload.

title: Australian-Experienced Xero Bookkeeper / Accountant – E-commerce
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We are a Melbourne-based online retail business looking for an experienced Bookkeeper / Accountant with strong hands-on experience working with Australian businesses.



This will initially be a project-based role focused on cleaning up approximately 18 months of historical accounting records, transferring the records from Excel into Xero, completing reconciliations and leaving us with an accurate and properly structured accounting system.



Once the historical project is completed successfully, there is an opportunity for ongoing bookkeeping work.



Our sales are primarily through Amazon, eBay and direct online sales, so experience with e-commerce and inventory-based businesses would be highly regarded.



YOUR PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



- Set up and/or properly configure our Xero account

- Transfer approximately 18 months of historical accounting records from Excel into Xero

- Record and reconcile Amazon, eBay and direct sales

- Record supplier purchases, overseas imports and other business expenses

- Complete bank reconciliations across multiple bank accounts

- Review GST treatment and correctly classify transactions

- Identify missing, duplicated or incorrectly recorded transactions

- Review and reconcile accounts to ensure historical records are accurate

- Assist with inventory and stock-related accounting

- Ensure Xero is fully up to date after the historical cleanup

- Prepare Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet and other relevant financial reports

- Help provide product-level and business performance information where the available data allows

- Establish a clean bookkeeping process that can be maintained going forward



ONGOING OPPORTUNITY



After successful completion of the initial project, the role may continue with responsibilities such as:



Regular bookkeeping

Bank reconciliation

Sales and expense reconciliation

GST/BAS-related bookkeeping preparation

Maintaining Xero accurately and up to date

Monthly financial reporting

Supporting management with financial information when required



MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS



- Previous hands-on experience working with Australian businesses is MANDATORY.



Please do not apply if you have not previously handled bookkeeping/accounting for Australian businesses.



You must have:



- Strong hands-on Xero experience

- Good working knowledge of Australian GST and BAS requirements

- Strong bank reconciliation experience

- Experience with historical bookkeeping cleanup, catch-up bookkeeping or migration projects

- Experience connecting and reconciling bank accounts in Xero

- Good Excel skills

- Strong attention to detail

- Ability to identify accounting discrepancies rather than simply enter data

- Good written and spoken English

- Reliable internet connection and communication



HIGHLY REGARDED



Experience with any of the following will be an advantage:



Australian e-commerce businesses

Amazon

eBay

Shopify

Inventory accounting

Imported products and overseas supplier purchases

Multi-channel sales reconciliation



SELF-ASSESSMENT



Please rate yourself from 1 to 10 in each area:



Xero Accounting Software

Australian bookkeeping

Australian GST

BAS-related bookkeeping

Bank reconciliation

Historical bookkeeping / cleanup

Excel

E-commerce accounting

Inventory accounting

Amazon / eBay reconciliation



Please be realistic with your ratings. We will discuss these areas during the interview.



TO APPLY



Please send us:



1- Your CV / resume

2- Your completed Self-Assessment above

3- Answers to the following questions:

-How many years of bookkeeping/accounting experience do you have?

- How many years have you worked directly with Australian businesses?

-What type of Australian businesses have you worked with?

- Briefly explain your experience with Australian GST and BAS.

- What do you regularly do inside Xero?

- Have you completed a historical bookkeeping cleanup, catch-up or migration into Xero before? Please briefly explain one example.

- Have you worked with Amazon, eBay, Shopify or another e-commerce business?

- Have you worked with inventory-based businesses?

- What is your expected hourly rate in AUD?

- What is your current availability?

- Are you currently working for another employer or client? If yes, approximately how many hours per week?



MANDATORY 3-MINUTE INTRODUCTION VIDEO



> Please also provide a short video of approximately 3 minutes introducing yourself. <



In the video, please tell us:



A little about yourself

Your bookkeeping/accounting background

Your experience working with Australian businesses

Your experience with Xero

Your experience with GST, BAS and reconciliations

One historical cleanup or bookkeeping problem you have personally handled

Why you believe you are suitable for this project



- Please upload the video to Loom or Google Drive and provide a link.



If using Google Drive, make sure the sharing permission allows us to view the video without requesting access.



IMPORTANT



Applications without previous Australian business bookkeeping experience will not be considered.



Applications that do not include the Self-Assessment and introduction video may also not be reviewed.



We are looking for someone who can take ownership of the historical cleanup, identify problems, ask the right questions and leave us with accurate and reliable accounts, not someone who only performs basic data entry.



This is initially a project-based engagement, with a genuine opportunity to become our ongoing bookkeeper if the initial project is completed successfully.

title: Experienced Amazon Online Arbitrage Product Sourcer — Keepa + SellerAmp Required
description:
# Experienced Amazon Online Arbitrage Product Sourcer — Keepa + SellerAmp Required



**Type:** Part-Time with potential to become Full-Time

**Hours:** 20 hours per week

**Starting Pay:** $7–$8 USD/hour, based on demonstrated experience

**Location:** Remote — 

**Position:** Long-term for the right person



## About the Role



Arkadia Arbitrage is a U.S.-based ecommerce business looking for a **highly experienced Amazon Online Arbitrage Product Sourcer**.



This is **not an entry-level Amazon VA position** and it is not a general ecommerce assistant role.



Your primary responsibility will be simple:



**Find legitimate, profitable, purchase-ready inventory opportunities for our Amazon FBA business.**



We are specifically looking for someone who already knows how to source independently using tools such as **Keepa, Revseller and SellerAmp SAS,  and who understands the difference between a product that looks profitable at first glance and an opportunity that is actually safe and sensible to purchase.**



You should already be comfortable analyzing:



* Keepa price and Buy Box history

* Sales velocity

* Amazon sales rank / BSR

* Seller competition

* FBA seller counts

* Price stability

* ROI and net profit

* Amazon presence on a listing

* Variations and pack counts

* Exact product matching

* UPC / model number verification

* Purchase limits and available quantity

* Seller eligibility / restrictions

* Potential IP or listing risks



**This position is focused specifically on Amazon FBA sourcing. Walmart, eBay, customer service, listing management, and general administrative work are not part of this role.**



## What You Will Do



You will use online arbitrage sourcing strategies to identify profitable products from legitimate U.S. retailers and suppliers.



Sourcing methods may include:



* Manual sourcing

* Reverse sourcing

* Storefront stalking

* Brand sourcing

* Retailer sourcing

* Keepa Product Finder

* Category and product research

* Other proven OA sourcing techniques you already use successfully



You will document qualified opportunities in our sourcing tracker with accurate supporting information.



We already maintain a large internal list of brands and products that our Amazon account is eligible to sell. You will therefore have clear sourcing areas to explore rather than starting completely from scratch.



## Our General Buying Standards



Qualified leads will generally need to meet standards such as:



* **30%+ ROI**

* **$3+ estimated net profit per unit**

* **30+ estimated monthly sales**

* Reasonable seller competition, generally no more than approximately 15–20 FBA sellers

* Stable enough pricing to support the purchase

* Exact product / listing match

* Correct size, count, variation, model, and UPC where applicable

* Product available from a legitimate retailer or supplier

* Meaningful quantity available for purchase



These are guidelines rather than an invitation to submit borderline products just because they technically reach a number.



**Quality matters more than quantity.**



Our goal is approximately **1–2 strong, genuinely actionable sourcing opportunities daily and 4-5 per week**, with enough available inventory behind those opportunities to support meaningful purchasing.



For example:



**Four excellent leads supporting $950 of sensible inventory purchases are more valuable to us than five weak leads supporting only $200.**



A lead only counts as successful when it is something we could reasonably purchase—not simply because it was entered into a spreadsheet.



## Required Experience



Please apply only if you already have significant hands-on experience sourcing Online Arbitrage products for Amazon FBA.



You should be proficient with:



* **Keepa**

* **SellerAmp SAS**

* Amazon product and listing analysis

* Google Sheets

* Online Arbitrage sourcing



You should be able to look at a Keepa chart and explain what the pricing and sales history tells you rather than simply reporting the current Buy Box price.



You should also understand that two products that look similar are **not automatically the same product**. Exact UPC, model, quantity, packaging, flavor, color, size, or variation differences must be investigated before recommending a purchase.



## What We Are Looking For



The ideal person:



* Has successfully sourced profitable OA products for other Amazon sellers

* Can work independently without constant training

* Is analytical and detail-oriented

* Understands Amazon listing risk

* Does not submit leads just to meet a quota

* Communicates clearly when something is questionable

* Is willing to reject a lead when the data does not support buying it

* Can explain the reasoning behind their recommendations

* Wants a stable, long-term position with a growing ecommerce business



We value **accuracy, judgment, and purchasing value** more than raw lead volume.



## Paid Sourcing Test



Strong applicants will be invited to complete a **paid sourcing test** before a final hiring decision is made.



You will receive specific sourcing criteria and will be asked to locate a small number of real OA opportunities.



The test will evaluate:



* Product matching accuracy

* Keepa analysis

* Profitability analysis

* Sales and competition analysis

* Source quality

* Available purchasing quantity

* Overall judgment



You will be paid for the test regardless of whether you are ultimately selected.



## How to Apply



Begin your application with the words:



**Arkadia SOURCING**



Applications that do not include those words will not be considered.



Then answer the following questions:



1. How many years have you personally sourced Online Arbitrage products for Amazon FBA?



2. Which sourcing methods do you use most often? Please be specific.



3. How would you describe your experience level with Keepa and SellerAmp?



4. When reviewing a Keepa chart, what are the most important things you examine before recommending that a client purchase inventory?



5. How do you verify that a retailer's product is an exact match to the Amazon listing?



6. Describe one successful OA product you previously sourced. You may remove or hide the actual product name/ASIN if necessary, but please provide the approximate:



   * Purchase cost

   * Amazon selling price

   * Profit

   * ROI

   * Estimated sales

   * Quantity the client was able to purchase



7. Approximately how many **purchase-ready** OA opportunities were you typically able to provide clients in a 20-hour workweek?



  

8. Are you currently working for other Amazon sellers? If yes, approximately how many hours per week?



9. Please tell us why you believe you would be a strong fit for a role focused specifically on **high-quality Amazon OA sourcing**.



Please do not send a generic application describing every type of virtual-assistant work you can perform. We are specifically hiring an experienced Amazon OA product sourcer.



Thank you. We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Part-Time Executive Assistant + Marketing & Operations Coordinator
description:

We operate across Airbnb, VRBO, Guesty for Pros, and our direct booking website — and we hold ourselves to the highest standards of hospitality, communication, and professionalism.

We are fast-growing and need a right-hand person who can run with us — not just follow a checklist.

"We don't want task-takers. We want strategic thinkers who anticipate needs, solve problems before they escalate, and take ownership as if this is their own business."



THE ROLE

This is not a standard VA position. You will operate as a hybrid Senior Guest Operations Manager, Executive Assistant to our CEO, and Luxury Brand Manager. You will own your responsibilities end-to-end and be expected to identify gaps, propose solutions, and execute without being micromanaged.



Guest Operations & Communications



Manage all guest communications across Airbnb, VRBO, Guesty for Pros, and our direct booking website — before, during, and after each stay

Resolve urgent and sensitive guest issues with poise, professionalism, and a guest-first mindset

Monitor guest inquiries in real time and respond within platform-required windows

Coordinate with cleaning, maintenance, and operations teams to ensure timely turnovers and perfect home readiness

Monitor and uphold SOPs, checklists, and company standards to deliver consistent 5-star experiences

Take initiative during off-script or high-pressure situations and implement preventative solutions

Prepare operational reports, identify patterns, and suggest improvements to leadership

Xenia Stays | Remote | 3 Hours Per Day



About Xenia Stays

title: Marketing Lead
description:
Marketing Assistant Role



Marketing / Creative Lead

Their purpose is:

Turn Quarters strategy into consistently strong, on-brand marketing execution across every client.

They are not just coordinating creatives. They are responsible for making sure the creative standard exists, is maintained and actually gets delivered.



What you own

1. Creative direction

They establish and maintain the visual direction for each client:

Brand moodboards

Visual references

Social grid direction

Static ad direction and design

Photography and shoot direction

Typography, colour and layout consistency

Content formats and recurring series

Campaign visual concepts

Reference brands and inspiration

Quality control across all published assets

They should be able to look at a client’s social media, ads,
s and website and immediately recognise when something feels off-brand.

They become the guardian of each client’s brand expression.



2. Hands-on static design

At your current size, they should absolutely be capable of producing design work themselves.

That should include:

Static Meta ads

Carousels

Promotional graphics

Social media posts

Campaign announcements

Story assets

 banners

Basic website graphics

Moodboards and visual presentations

Simple brand guideline documents

They do not need to be an elite graphic designer capable of complex identity projects.



They do need:

Strong taste

Excellent Canva or Adobe ability

A clear understanding of hierarchy

Good typography

Commercial design instincts

The ability to model high-performing references without producing generic work

The standard should be:

“Can this person independently create a strong static campaign that Sean would be comfortable presenting to a client?”



3. Marketing campaign execution



They should be able to take a commercial goal such as:

Launch a new collection

Increase online revenue

Promote a seasonal offer

Improve customer retention

Launch a new website

Introduce a new service



And convert it into:

Campaign objective

Core message

Offer

Content angles

Static concepts

Video concepts

Organic content

Paid creative requirements

 campaign requirements

Schedule

Deadlines

Responsibilities

Launch plan

They should not wait for you to prescribe every individual post.

You provide the higher-level diagnosis and direction. They build and execute the campaign around it.



4. Process building

This should be an explicit part of the role—not something you hope they do eventually.

They should build and continuously improve:

Client onboarding workflow

Brand immersion process

Campaign planning template

Content calendar system

Creative briefing template

Static ad production workflow

Video editing workflow

Approval process

Content scheduling process

Shoot planning system

Asset naming and file storage

Weekly client review process

Performance-to-creative feedback loop

Client offboarding or handover process

Each time they complete a task, they should ask:

“How do we turn this into a system that someone else can follow?”

That is how the role evolves from doing everything themselves into eventually managing a larger creative team.



5. Content operations

They should own the full flow from idea to publication:

Strategy ? concept ? brief ? production ? review ? approval ? scheduling ? performance review

That includes:

Ensuring content is planned ahead

Briefing editors

Briefing creators

Creating static assets

Reviewing initial edits

Managing client approvals

Maintaining content reserves

Scheduling approved content

Flagging missing assets

Reporting what performed

Updating future creative based on results

They own whether content is ready—not merely whether they sent someone a message about it.



6. Client activation

This is especially important for solving your current bottleneck.

Once you close a new client, the Marketing Manager should be capable of moving them through:

Onboarding

Access collection

Brand immersion

Existing asset review

Campaign priorities

Visual direction

Content plan

Creative briefs

Production

Approval

Scheduling

Active campaign delivery

You should still lead strategic workshops and major commercial decisions, but the Marketing Manager should drive the client from signed to operational.



What the role is not



The main Meta buyer

A full-time video editor

A website developer

A customer service assistant

A project manager who produces nothing

A social media scheduler waiting for instructions

A junior designer who cannot make campaign decisions

They need to combine creative judgement, hands-on production and operational ownership.



The ideal candidate profile

You are looking for someone who is:

Creatively led

Commercially aware

Strong at static design

Extremely organised

Capable of building systems

Comfortable taking ownership

Able to give clear feedback to editors

Interested in brands, campaigns and consumer psychology

Fast without becoming careless

Able to move between fashion, health, beauty, travel and other clients

Confident enough to challenge weak creative

Resourceful enough to solve problems without waiting for you



Their portfolio should show more than attractive posts.

You want evidence that they can create:

Cohesive brand worlds

Campaign concepts

Conversion-focused statics

Social media systems

Clear visual direction

Commercially relevant creative

title: Graphic Designer - Product Packaging & Print Design | Project + Ongoing Opportunity
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for an experienced Graphic Designer with strong hands-on experience in product packaging and print design.



This is not primarily a social media or digital design position. We need someone who understands how to take a packaging concept from design through to print-ready production.



You will work across different consumer products and brands, creating and improving packaging, labels and other printed materials.



The role will initially be project-based, with the opportunity for ongoing design work for the right person.



YOUR PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



* Design product packaging from concept through to final artwork

* Create and modify labels, boxes, pouches, sleeves and other product packaging

* Work with existing brand guidelines and maintain consistency across packaging

* Prepare professional print-ready artwork

* Work accurately with printer-supplied dielines and templates

* Check dimensions, bleed, margins, colour setup and print specifications

* Prepare CMYK and other production files as required by printers

* Make artwork revisions based on printer feedback and production requirements

* Adapt existing packaging designs for different products, sizes or variations

* Create product inserts, cards, flyers and other printed collateral when required

* Organise source files properly so they can easily be updated in the future

* Communicate with our team and, when required, help resolve artwork or print-production issues



MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS



You must have genuine previous experience designing packaging that has actually been commercially printed.



You should have:



* Strong graphic design experience

* Strong product packaging design experience

* Experience preparing artwork for professional printing

* Good understanding of dielines and packaging templates

* Good understanding of bleed, trim, margins and print-safe areas

* Strong Adobe Illustrator skills

* Strong Adobe Photoshop skills

* Ability to prepare clean and organised editable source files

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to follow printer specifications accurately

* Ability to work independently and solve design and production problems

* Good written and spoken English

* Reliable communication and availability



IMPORTANT



We are specifically looking for someone with real packaging and print-production experience.



If your experience is mainly social media posts, Canva graphics, website banners or digital marketing design, this position is probably not suitable.



We want to see packaging projects that you personally designed and prepared for actual commercial printing.



HIGHLY REGARDED



Experience with the following will be an advantage:



* Food and consumer-product packaging

* Labels and flexible packaging

* Boxes and cartons

* Retail product packaging

* Working directly with commercial printers

* Preparing multiple product variations or SKUs

* Creating packaging within established brand guidelines

* Australian businesses or Australian printing companies



SELF-ASSESSMENT



Please rate yourself from 1 to 10 in each area:



1. Adobe Illustrator

2. Adobe Photoshop

3. Product packaging design

4. Print-ready artwork preparation

5. Working with dielines

6. Prepress / commercial printing knowledge

7. Label design

title: Join Our Star Wars YouTube Team as a Long Form Video Editor
description:
**Not just another editing job. We're looking for a storyteller.**

title: Client & Content Coordinator
description:
About Winnipeg Digest

Winnipeg Digest is a fast-growing local news and lifestyle brand that keeps Winnipeggers in the loop on what's happening in their city: news, food, events, community stories, and local guides.



We reach a large, engaged local audience across
 and social. Local businesses pay us to get in front of this audience in a way that feels like a trusted recommendation, not a boring ad.



You’d be joining a small, ambitious team where your work directly impacts revenue and is seen by hundreds of thousands of locals every week.



The Role

We’re looking for a Client & Content Coordinator to be the “glue” between our founder, our writer, and our audience.



Your job is to keep our CRM and client communication organized, be a second set of eyes on our flagship newsletter, and repurpose content into consistent social posts. When you do this well, our founder can spend most of his time on sales.



This is a mix of light client communication, structured admin, and content support. You don’t need to be a marketing guru, but you must be organized, write clean English, and love checklists.



What You’ll Do Day‑to‑Day

CRM & Sales Support (Notion + Gmail)

• Keep our Notion CRM up to date after sales calls (stages, next steps, follow‑up dates, deal values).

• Draft follow‑up and recap
s from templates in clear, natural English.

• After an initial review period, send routine follow‑ups and recaps yourself.



Client Communication (light but important)

 clients to:

• Collect assets (logos, copy, links)

• Confirm ad dates and details

• Send performance recap reports

• Flag any sensitive or high‑stakes questions to the founder.



Newsletter Second Eyes (Beehiiv + Google Docs)

• Work closely with our writer to review each newsletter before it goes out.

• Check links, formatting, event counts, spacing, images, and obvious typos.

• Make sure issues follow our structure and checklists.

• Support basic assembly where needed; our writer still leads the build in Beehiiv.



Social Repurposing (Instagram &
)

• Turn newsletter content and existing reels into carousels and posts in Canva.

• Write short, engaging captions in our friendly local voice (we provide examples).

• Schedule posts consistently using Meta Business Suite (or similar).

• Keep a simple content calendar up to date.



Analytics & Reporting

• Pull basic metrics from Beehiiv and Instagram (opens, clicks, reach, etc.).

• Drop them into simple internal tracking sheets and client recap templates.



Must‑Have Skills

• Strong written English: clear, natural, and typo‑free
s and captions.

• Detail‑oriented: you catch broken links, formatting issues, and inconsistencies.

• Experience with:

          • Canva

          • Instagram /
 for a brand

          • Basic spreadsheets (Google Sheets)

• Comfortable working daily in tools like Notion, Gmail, Google Docs, Meta Business Suite.

• Highly organized and reliable: you hit deadlines without needing to be chased.

• Able to work 10:00 AM–6:00 PM CST, Monday–Friday, plus ~2–3 hours most Sundays (with lighter Fridays those weeks).



Nice to Have (Not Required)

• Experience with
 newsletters (Beehiiv, Mailchimp, etc.).

• Past experience in a coordinator / VA / client success role.

• Interest in local news, food, and community content.



What Success Looks Like After 90 Days

• Our CRM is always current; no leads or follow‑ups fall through the cracks.

• Clients routinely receive clear recap
s and feel looked after.

• Newsletter issues ship clean with minimal last‑minute fixes.

• Social content goes out consistently without the founder touching it.

• The founder spends most of his day on sales and strategy, not admin.



How to Apply

Please apply using this Google Form: 



In the form, you’ll be asked to:

1. Share a short introduction about yourself and your experience.

2. Confirm your country, time zone, and that you can work the stated hours.

3. Confirm you’re comfortable with the pay for a full‑time role.

4. Provide links or screenshots of:

          • Social posts or carousels you’ve created.

          • Any professional
 or written communication you’re proud of (you can redact names).





Please include the word “COORDINATOR” at the top of your introduction so we know you read this carefully.





What happens next:

• If you’re a fit on hours, pay, and basic skills, we’ll invite you to complete a short skills test (sample social posts, recap
, and simple CRM task).

• From there, top candidates will be invited to a brief video interview.

title: Sports Video Editor (Freelance)
description:
Sports Video Editor (Freelance / Remote)

About South Bay Blasters

South Bay Blasters is a youth baseball nonprofit organization focused on developing athletes, building confidence, and creating memorable experiences through competitive baseball.



We are seeking a skilled Sports Video Editor to create high-quality cinematic baseball content that showcases our teams, players, and game experiences.

Position Overview

This freelance remote role focuses on editing long-form baseball highlight videos featuring scoring graphics, motion graphics, and cinematic storytelling inspired by professional sports content.



Most final deliverables will average approximately 15 minutes in runtime depending on the game and project scope.



Editors will be expected to provide an initial rough cut within 24 hours of receiving raw footage, with final edited videos delivered within 48 hours.



This position is estimated at approximately 10–20 hours per week during the season.

• Collaborate with the South Bay Blasters team on creative direction and branding

• Adobe Premiere Pro

• Final Cut Pro

• Adobe After Effects

• Adobe Photoshop

Ideal Candidate

• Professional-level video editing experience

• Strong understanding of baseball and sports storytelling

• Experience editing sports-related content

• Strong eye for pacing, music syncing, graphics, and cinematic visuals

• Organized, detail-oriented, and able to meet deadlines

• The catch phrase is “cinematic gold”

• Able to work independently and communicate effectively in a remote environment

Position Details

• Freelance / Contract Position

• Fully Remote

• Approximately 10–20 hours per week

• Pay per project based on experience and scope of work

Perks

• Opportunity for consistent project work throughout the season

• Creative involvement in building the South Bay Blasters brand

• Ability to contribute creative direction and editing style to projects

Application Requirements

• Resume

• Portfolio with sports editing samples

• Relevant social media/video links (if applicable)

• Final candidates will participate in a paid turnaround test edit as part of the hiring process
