title: Home Health Healthcare Recruiter
description:
Full-Time | Remote | Exclusive to Sterling Staffing Solutions



Sterling Staffing Solutions is looking for an experienced, motivated, and enthusiastic Healthcare Recruiter to join our team and lead full-cycle recruiting efforts.

We are looking for someone who enjoys connecting with people, finding great talent, and helping candidates discover exciting career opportunities. This role is perfect for a recruiter who is proactive, organized, confident, and knows how to build strong relationships with candidates from the first conversation through the hiring process.

If you have strong healthcare recruiting experience, direct Home health recruiting experience, and excellent communication skills, we would love to hear from you!



What You'll Do

As our Healthcare Recruiter, you will manage the recruiting process from start to finish across multiple locations. Your responsibilities will include:

Sourcing and engaging qualified candidates

Reviewing resumes and screening applicants

Conducting candidate outreach and follow-up

Coordinating interviews

Helping candidates navigate the hiring process

Maintaining active and organized candidate pipelines

Supporting successful hires and onboarding efforts

Recruiting for hospice and healthcare-related positions

Representing our organization professionally and sharing what makes our opportunities unique

We are looking for someone who is comfortable taking initiative, building relationships, and keeping candidates engaged throughout the hiring process.



What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is confident, responsive, organized, and comfortable communicating with a wide variety of people. You should enjoy sourcing talent, building connections, and helping candidates feel excited about new opportunities.

Strong communication and follow-up skills are especially important in this role. We are looking for someone who can not only identify qualified candidates but also build trust, create interest, and help guide candidates toward accepting the right opportunity.

This is a fully dedicated position, and we are looking for someone who can commit exclusively to Sterling Staffing Solutions.

Ideal Candidate

The right person is proactive, dependable, persuasive, and motivated. You know how to find and engage healthcare professionals and understand the importance of maintaining strong candidate relationships.

You are comfortable managing multiple job openings at once, staying organized, moving quickly, and communicating clearly. Experience recruiting specifically within the hospice or home health industry is highly important for success in this role.



Requirements

To be considered, you must meet the following requirements:

Minimum of 1 - 2 years of healthcare recruiting experience

Strong full-cycle recruiting experience

Proven ability to source, engage, and successfully close candidates

Excellent English communication skills, both spoken and written

Ability to communicate comfortably, naturally, and professionally with American candidates and hiring teams

Strong candidate follow-up and relationship-building skills

Ability to manage multiple openings and priorities simultaneously

Must be fully dedicated to Sterling Staffing Solutions (No other active jobs, clients, contracts, or other work commitments)



Why This Role Matters

This is an important role within our organization. The Healthcare Recruiter will play a direct part in helping us build strong teams across all four of our locations.

We are looking for someone who takes pride in their work, enjoys helping people find meaningful opportunities, and understands the importance of hiring talented individuals who align with our mission and standards.

If you are passionate about recruiting, enjoy connecting with people, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we would love to meet you!



How to Apply

When applying, please include a short message answering the following questions:

How many years of healthcare recruiting experience do you have?

How many years of direct home health or hospice recruiting experience do you have?

What healthcare positions have you recruited for?

Are you currently working for any other employer or client?

Can you commit exclusively to Sterling Staffing Solutions?

Why do you believe you are a strong fit for this role?

title: Lead Virtual Assistant — Serviced Accommodation Operations (Career Role, Growth Track)
description:
About the role



Key Let Management (Key Let Stays) is a fast growing serviced accommodation company based in Manchester, UK. We've scaled from 2 units to 15 in the past few months and we need someone sharp to take genuine ownership of day to day operations, so the founder can focus on sales and growth.



This is not a task based VA job. This is a career opportunity for someone who wants to grow into an Operations Manager role, hiring and training their own team of VAs as we scale.



What you'll own



Guest communication across all channels

Landlord liaison and relationship management

Cleaning and maintenance coordination

Driving direct bookings and revenue growth using PriceLabs

Working closely with our automation specialist to shape and refine our systems (Uplisting, Slack, Notion, Zapier, PriceLabs, Suiteop)

Full ownership of building and maintaining our SOPs. As processes are established and refined, you're responsible for documenting them properly, keeping them up to date, and making sure they're clear enough for a new hire to follow without needing you to explain it live. This is one of the most important parts of the role, as it's what allows us to bring on and train future VAs under you.



What we need from you (mandatory)



Minimum 2 years' experience in a VA or operations role within short term rentals / Airbnb management

Proven leadership skills. You will eventually be hiring, training and managing your own team of VAs as we scale, so previous experience leading, training or supervising others is essential, not optional

Confident using a channel manager (Uplisting experience preferred)

Hands on experience with PriceLabs

Experience using Slack and Notion

Strong documentation skills. You should be someone who naturally writes things down properly as you learn them, not someone who keeps process knowledge in your head

Strong written English and clear communication



Nice to have



An open, adaptable mindset, ready to learn our full stack as we build it out together



Hours



8 hours per day, flexible within our 9am to 8pm operating window (UK time). Full overlap not required, but strong daytime coverage is essential.



Pay



$7 to $8 USD per hour to start, with a clear path to progression as you prove yourself. Performance based incentives on top of base pay as you help drive bookings and revenue. We invest in our team and reward great work, this is not a role where you'll be left to work hard with nothing in return.



We reward great work. If you come in to the business and make a huge impact it will be rewarded.



Why this role is different



As we scale, you won't just be operating the business, you'll be shaping how it runs, and the SOPs you build will become the backbone of our training process for every VA hired under you. If you do great work, there's no reason you won't be with us for years, growing into a genuine leadership position as we bring on more units and more VAs under you.

title: Media Buyer for Online Gaming: Google Tag Manager, Pixels, Paid Traffic ($1,500-$2,500/mo)
description:
ABOUT US



We're a startup building two online gaming brands (online casinos) serving international markets. We're well-funded, moving extremely fast, and building an AI-first company from day one. We run lean, automate aggressively, and every person on the team is expected to multiply their output with AI tools. You'll work remotely as part of the founding team's inner circle.



THE ROLE



We're looking for a media buyer to run paid acquisition for our casino brands. Junior is fine. What is not negotiable is that you understand the technical side very deeply. Plenty of "media buyers" can click around an ads dashboard. We need someone who actually understands what's happening underneath.



You must understand, in depth:

- How to set up Google Tag Manager properly: containers, tags, triggers, variables

- How to set up and debug pixels and conversion tracking across platforms (Meta pixel, Google tags, server-side events, postbacks)

- How attribution actually works, and what breaks it

- The fundamentals of running spend: CPC, CPM, CPA, ROAS, budgets, bids, and how to read the numbers honestly

- How to structure campaigns, test creatives, and scale what works without torching the budget



What you'll actually do:

- Own tracking setup end to end: GTM, pixels, conversion events, testing that every event actually fires

- Set up, launch, and manage paid campaigns for our gaming brands

- Monitor spend and performance daily and report the numbers straight

- Test creatives and audiences constantly, kill losers fast, scale winners

- Use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) to move faster on analysis, creative variations, and reporting



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We have a clear preference for energetic, early-career people who can go all-in on this role: high energy, fully available, hungry to make this the thing they build their career on. This is a young, high-energy startup environment, and the hours are real.



- Technically deep on tracking. GTM and pixels are not buzzwords to you. You will be tested on this in detail on a live call.

- A real media buyer. You've spent actual budgets and can talk through what you did, what worked, and what you learned when it didn't.

- iGaming experience helps. If you've bought traffic for casino, betting, or gaming offers, tell us. It's a big advantage.

- Fluent English. You'll be on weekly calls with the team, and your spoken English will be tested on the call.

- Honest with numbers. We'd rather hear a campaign is failing than see a dressed-up report. Non-negotiable.



COMPENSATION



$1,500-$2,500 USD per month (approx. PHP 85,
,000), depending on experience and how deep your technical skills run. We pay above market because we want someone genuinely good, and as our spend grows, this role and its pay grow with it.



THE HIRING PROCESS



Every hire here goes through a live video call with us. We will test your spoken English, we will test how sharp you are, and we will go deep on GTM, pixels, and campaign management. We offer very competitive salaries, so the bar is high: only if you're really good will we hire you. If you're the real deal, you'll enjoy the call.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply directly to Rodney Thomas:
 
 or WhatsApp 
. Applications that skip these steps will not be read:



1. Start your application with the word "Pixel" so we know you read this far.

2. In 200 words or less: walk us through how you would set up conversion tracking for a new brand from zero: GTM, pixels, events, and how you verify everything fires correctly.

3. Tell us about a campaign you've run: platform, budget, CPC/CPA, and what you did when performance dropped.

4. Attach your CV and your LinkedIn profile URL.

title: Video Editor
description:
Hi — I'm Dylan.



I run a land investing company in the US. We buy raw land, and over the next four months I'm filming a weekly YouTube series documenting me rebuilding one part of the business completely from scratch — the real version, including the parts that don't work.



I'm looking for one editor to own all of the video output. Not a project. An ongoing role through the end of the year and beyond if it goes well.



What you'd be editing every week

1 long-form YouTube episode — 12 to 20 minutes, documentary / vlog style

4–5 short-form clips cut from that same footage, for Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts

1 thumbnail per episode, generated using AI image tools



The raw footage is deliberately messy: recorded phone calls, screen recordings of software, me talking to camera, and calls with my team. Your job is turning that pile into something people actually finish watching.



What I actually care about

Retention. Tight cuts, no dead air, no 30-second intro. If three seconds are boring, they're gone.

You can find the story in the footage. I'm not handing you a script or a shot list. You get the footage and a few lines about what the episode is about. If you need to be told exactly what to do with every clip, this isn't the right role.

Clean on-screen text and simple graphics — numbers, labels, callouts. Not motion design. Readable and consistent.

Captions on everything.

You hit deadlines without me chasing you. This is the big one.

Requirements

Real experience editing long-form YouTube — talking head, vlog, or documentary style. Please don't apply if your portfolio is only wedding videos, corporate explainers, or gaming montages. It's a different skill and I'll be able to tell.

Strong short-form skills. You understand that the first second d
 whether the other 29 get watched.

Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut. CapCut is fine for shorts.

Comfortable making thumbnails with AI image tools (Midjourney, Nano Banana, Photoshop generative fill — whatever you actually use). I don't need a graphic designer. I need someone who can iterate on a thumbnail fast.

Written English good enough to understand my notes and to ask me a question when something is unclear.

Reliable internet and the ability to move large video files without drama.

Nice to have

You watch business / finance YouTube and know what good looks like in this space

Experience cutting recorded sales or phone calls into watchable segments

You have opinions about editing and are willing to tell me when I'm wrong about something

Hours, pay, and how we'd work

Part-time, roughly 15–20 hours per week

$800/month to start, moving to $1,000/month after a 60-day review if the work is good

You set your own hours. I care about deadlines, not when you work. I'm in California (PST).

Weekly rhythm: I drop the footage Friday, you deliver a first cut Monday, revisions and shorts Tuesday, we publish Tuesday.

First episode publishes September 16, so I'm hiring this week.

Paid on time, every time, twice a month.

How to apply



Put LAND SERIES in the subject line, and include:



Links to 2 long-form videos you edited — tell me specifically which decisions were yours

Links to 2 short-form videos you edited

One thumbnail you made with AI, and which tool you used

What software you edit in

How many hours per week you have available right now

Answer this: what's one thing you would cut from almost every YouTube video to make it better?



I won't read applications without "LAND SERIES" in the subject line or without portfolio links.



Shortlisted applicants get a paid test project — I'll send you real footage and pay you for one short edit before I d
. I don't ask people to work for free.



Thanks for reading this far, Dylan

description:
STAFF AUDITOR

Premier Group Services, Inc. (PG)



SUMMARY

Are you organized, detail-oriented, and a strategic thinker with excellent communication skills? If so, this position may interest you.



Premier Group Services, Inc. (PG) is a Veteran-Owned, Woman-Owned CPA and management consulting firm offering clients a team of skilled experts with the experience and innovation to navigate the most complex and challenging Accounting, Auditing, and Taxation issues for government and nonprofit organizations.



PG is growing — we're looking for future leaders and dynamic, talented individuals to join our audit team as Staff Auditors. In this role, you'll take ownership and complete all deliverables associated with each government auditee.



ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Your day-to-day will include:



Upon assignment of the auditee, complete planning workpapers, including a request for the appropriate PBC documents. Planning should consider the client's objectives, structure, policies, procedures, internal controls, and external regulations. Audit engagements are performed in accordance with Generally Accepted Auditing Standards (GAAS) or Generally Accepted Government Auditing Standards (GAGAS).

Identify risk areas and prepare audit programs to respond to and address those risks

Complete internal control workpapers

Select and request sample support using known audit and statistical techniques

Complete substantive and compliance test workpapers

Summarize the work performed and prepare the schedule of findings and recommendations, including appropriate criteria, federal regulations, and accounting standards

Actively engage with clients and maintain exceptional working relationships; conduct entrance and exit conferences with the auditee

Prepare the final audit report to be delivered to the client

Mentor interns on the audit process and provide feedback for improvement

Attend professional development and training sessions regularly to meet or exceed continuing professional education (CPE) requirements



QUALIFICATIONS

A strong candidate will have:



2 years of recent and relevant nonprofit & government entities' external financial audit experience, with 1 year of experience applying the Code of Federal Regulations and GAGAS

Prior experience with timekeeping systems and project management software such as QuickBooks and AuditFile

Excellent computer skills, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint

Strong attention to detail, organization, and communication, with high integrity and adherence to ethical standards

Ability to handle confidential information and work well with diverse individuals at all levels

title: AI-Powered Long-Form Video Editor
description:
We’re looking for a strong long-form editor who combines editorial judgment with an efficient AI-assisted workflow.



AI can already handle basic tasks such as transcription, silence removal, filler cleanup, and rough cuts. What matters more to us is your ability to decide what should stay, what should go, what should move, and how to make the final video stronger.



Our team uses tools such as Descript, CapCut, Claude, and other AI tools, but you should ideally have your own stack and workflow as well.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



• Edit long-form video from raw footage through final delivery

• Remove filler, repetition, weak tangents, mistakes, and unnecessary sections

• Improve structure, pacing, clarity, and flow

• Identify strong openings and key moments

• Add B-roll, graphics, supporting visuals, and audio cleanup where needed

• Identify potential short-form clips while reviewing footage

• Use AI to speed up transcript review, cleanup, rough cuts, organization, research, and repetitive tasks

• Build repeatable workflows that improve turnaround time

• Recommend better tools or processes when appropriate



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



• Strong long-form editing skills

• Excellent editorial judgment

• Ability to recognize when a clean edit is still boring

• Experience using AI as part of your actual editing workflow

• Your own preferred editing/AI stack

• Ability to independently learn and test new tools

• Strong organization and reliable turnaround

• Ability to make editorial decisions without needing every cut dictated



HOW TO APPLY



To apply, send both of the following directly to Alex on Instagram:



1. Your portfolio with relevant editing samples

2. A short selfie video introducing yourself and briefly sharing your editing experience and how you use AI in your workflow









Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete a paid editing test.



Compensation: $600–$900/month depending on experience, quality, speed, and test performance.

description:

Remote | Philippines-Based | Full-Time



Approx. PHP 48,000 - 80,000/month full-time ($4.50 - $7.50 USD/hour, paid in USD; PHP amount varies with exchange rate)



Can you take raw footage and turn it into a scroll-stopping ad? Do you know why a viewer drops off at second 3 -- and how to re-cut the hook so they don't? If editing is your craft and volume doesn't scare you, keep reading.



We're hiring a Video Editor on behalf of a U.S.-based marketing agency serving home service and remodeling brands. You'll produce the video creative that powers real ad campaigns -- working alongside a team of media buyers and copywriters whose campaigns live or die on the quality of your edits. When your video converts, everyone sees it in the numbers.



This is a production role with real output expectations: a minimum of 30 edited pieces of content per week. If you're fast, consistent, and take pride in clean work at volume, you'll thrive here.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Editing & Production:

- Edit a minimum of 30 pieces of content per week -- primarily short-form vertical video (ads, social clips, talking-head content, before/after project footage)

- Cut raw client footage into polished, caption-ready edits with strong hooks, tight pacing, and clean audio

- Produce multiple variations of winning ads (new hooks, new CTAs, new openers) for A/B testing

- Format 
 correctly for
, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube placements



Collaboration:

- Work directly with media buyers to understand which creatives are performing and iterate on winners

- Turn copywriters' scripts and hooks into finished video

- Manage your queue through the team's project management system and hit deadlines without chasing



Organization & Quality:

- Maintain organized project files, brand assets, and templates for each client

- Apply client branding consistently (logos, colors, fonts, end cards)

- Self-review every edit before delivery -- clean captions, no dead frames, correct aspect ratios



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- 2+ years of hands-on video editing experience

- Deep proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and/or CapCut -- you should be fast enough in your tool of choice to hit 6 finished edits per day

- A portfolio of short-form edits: ads, reels, TikToks, or YouTube Shorts

- Strong instincts for hooks, pacing, and retention -- you edit for the viewer who's about to scroll away

- Experience creating captions/subtitles and editing for sound-off viewing

- Organized, deadline-driven, and consistent -- volume work requires systems, not heroics

- Reliable home office setup with an editing-capable computer and stable, high-speed internet

- Availability for a consistent Monday-Friday full-time schedule with at least 3-4 hours of overlap with U.S. Pacific business hours for team communication (the rest of your day is flexible)



NICE TO HAVE



- Experience using AI tools in your workflow (Runway, Descript, ElevenLabs, CapCut AI features, Midjourney, HeyGen, or similar) -- we love editors who use AI to go faster without losing quality

- After Effects / motion graphics skills

- Experience editing direct-response ad creative with measurable results

- Experience with home services, construction, or local business content

- Thumbnail or static creative design skills (Canva, Photoshop)



When you apply, include the word FRAMEWORK in the "Anything else you'd like us to know?" field of the application form. This is how we know you read the full post.



WHAT'S INCLUDED



- $4.50 - $7.50 USD/hour, paid in USD (approx. PHP 48,000 - 80,000/month full-time) -- placement in the band depends on speed, skill level, and portfolio, with a formal review at 90 days

title: AI-Native Recruiter / Talent Sourcer: Work Directly With a Startup Founder ($2,500-$3,500/mo)
description:
ABOUT US

- AI-NATIVE. This is the #1 requirement. You use Claude and ChatGPT deeply and daily, not "I tried it once." You build your workflows around AI, keep up with new models and tools, and can show us how you use AI to do the work of three people. In your application, we'll ask you to prove it.

- Sharp and nimble. You learn fast, write well, communicate clearly in English, and don't need hand-holding after the first week.

- Trustworthy. You'll be working from the founder's own accounts and seeing the inside of the business. Discretion and reliability are non-negotiable.

COMPENSATION



$2,500-$3,500 USD per month (approx. PHP 140,
,000), depending on experience and how strong your AI + recruitment skillset is. We deliberately pay at the very top of the market because we want a genuinely exceptional person, and we promote from within. The ceiling on this role is high.

We offer very competitive salaries, so the bar is high: only if you're really good will we hire you. If you're the real deal, you'll enjoy the call.

title: Video Editor
description:
Role Summary



We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Video Editor to help turn raw footage videos, educational content, and social media clips into polished, engaging content for a brand.



You'll work closely with the content team to edit videos that are visually appealing, clear, professional, and suited to platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and LinkedIn.



You should be able to identify the strongest moments in footage, create a compelling flow, maintain attention, and tell a story that supports the purpose of the content.





Typical Tasks & Responsibilities



A. Video Editing



→ Edit raw video footage into polished, professional content

→ Cut interviews, talking-head videos, educational content, and event footage

→ Select the strongest clips and remove unnecessary pauses, repetition, mistakes, and dead space

→ Create different versions of content for different platforms and formats

→ Maintain consistent visual quality and editing standards across all videos



B. Short-Form Content



→ Edit Instagram Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn videos

→ Create strong opening hooks that capture attention within the first few seconds

→ Edit videos with appropriate pacing to maintain viewer attention

→ Repurpose longer videos into multiple short-form pieces



C. Content Repurposing



→ Identify multiple content opportunities from a single recording or long-form video

→ Turn interviews, podcasts, webinars, and presentations into short-form content

→ Create multiple clips from existing footage for use across different platforms

→ Suggest additional content that can be created from available footage



D. Creative Direction & Storytelling



→ Review raw footage and identify the strongest storytelling opportunities

→ Make creative decisions around pacing, music, B-roll, text, transitions, and visual structure

→ Suggest hooks, opening sequences, or editing approaches where appropriate

→ Keep up with relevant video formats and editing trends without sacrificing the brand's professional positioning



E. Audio & Visual Quality



→ Clean up and improve audio where necessary

→ Balance voice, music, and sound effects

→ Ensure videos have clear and consistent audio

→ Perform basic colour correction and visual adjustments

→ Ensure videos are properly formatted and exported for their intended platforms



F. Brand Consistency



→ Follow established brand guidelines, fonts, colours, logos, and visual direction

→ Maintain a consistent editing style across content

→ Ensure videos look professional and aligned with the agent's positioning

→ Organize project files, footage, assets, and final exports properly



G. Collaboration & Content Workflow



→ Work with the content team to understand the purpose and desired outcome of each video

→ Take feedback professionally and make revisions efficiently

→ Meet agreed deadlines for content delivery

→ Keep track of videos in progress, completed edits, revisions, and final versions

→ Communicate clearly when additional footage, information, or clarification is required





Advantageous If Candidate:



→ Has previous experience editing real estate, lifestyle, personal brand, corporate, or educational content

→ Has experience with motion graphics, animation, kinetic typography, or advanced text effects

→ Has basic knowledge of colour grading and professional audio editing

→ Can create compelling thumbnails or has experience with Canva/Adobe Photoshop

→ Understands social media content strategy, hooks, retention, and audience behaviour

→ Has experience working with personal brands, entrepreneurs, executives, or real estate professionals

→ Can work independently and manage multiple editing projects without constant supervision

→ Has access to reliable internet and the equipment/software necessary to complete the work consistently





How to Apply



To apply, please complete the following:



1.Send your CV/resume and a link to your portfolio or previous video work.

2. Your portfolio must include at least 3 examples of short-form videos you have edited.

3. Use the following as your
/application subject line: [Your Name] – I Know How to Tell the Story



Applications who do not follow these steps will not be considered.

title: L2 Tech Support Engineer
description:
Dear Technology Lover!

We're a small (but VERY efficient) 20-year-old MSP based in Arizona.

As a small company. we're VERY employee-focused, and believe that our team members are our MOST IMPORTANT ASSET!



Here are some of the things you can expect from working with us:

• Ongoing (monthly) manager review and feedback- you should never guess where you are "standing" and what you, AND THE COMPANY, can do better!

• Paid certifications- we will pay for your courses and tests and allocate time during business hours to help you achieve your desired goals

• Paid Time Off- it's important to us that you are happy, healthy, and have a work-life balance!

• Bonuses- when the company wins, you win!

• Raises- As we grow, we believe you should as well. We have to stay competitive as an employer to retain our awesome employees!

• Opportunities to grow- In our industry, we can't be on "cruise control"... We need to push our team members to stay ahead of the technology curve. Help you continually sharpen your skills with a focus on your career aspirations.

• Paid sick days- We understand life happens. We don't want you to feel that you have to drag yourself to work sick if your body tells you to relax...



You're the right fit if you:

• LOVE learning, working with, and experimenting with new technology

• Get excited when you save someone's day and provide great service

• Are a hard-working, fun person, and see yourself being in the IT industry for the foreseeable future

• Want to work in a GROWING environment, with STABLE income, Bonuses, and a great attitude!

• Want the opportunity to advance and learn more!



Some of the responsibilities that your position will include are:

Helpdesk (mostly escalations, but some basic if needed), cyber security related tasks/ audits, cloud hosting and virtualization (HyperV, SonicWall, VPN), MS365 management and automation, BCDR (Axcient), networking (UniFi, SonicWall), IT projects, Servers maintenance (Windows only), scripts creation, testing new technology, and other tasks related to IT.



IMPORTANT:

This position requires AT LEAST 2 years of MSP experience and at least 2 years of experience in an L2 position, supervisory, or lead role. 100% clean background check, highly organized, technologically savvy, and can work diligently with little supervision. Several hiring steps will take place to verify the above requirements, including reference checking, employment verification, technical testing, and more.



Minimum technical level that you will need to be able to pass a test on:

• Explaining to a non-technical person what the "cloud" is

• Consulting with a new client on what BCDR solution you would recommend to an SMB, and why

• Explaining what the differences are between traditional anti-virus and XDR

• Creating a new Virtual Machine on a Hyper-V host, from an ISO file located on a different computer on the network.

• Explaining the differences and commonalities between SharePoint and OneDrive.

• Creating an Intune policy that will install Firefox on an Azure-joined VM, and make Firefox the default browser, with the specific home page we'll provide to you during the test.

• Several other situational and technical questions.

• CCNA certificate candidates preferred but not required.



MORE DETAILS:

• A PRE-EMPLOYMENT BACKGROUND CHECK is performed (at our expense). You must have 100% clean background check. Please do not apply if you don't have 100% clean background check.

• Personality is KEY for us. We are looking for an easy-going, yet professional, friendly, and HONEST person.

• You will be working from home. This means you must have a quiet work environment and no excessive background noise.

• FAST AND RELIABLE INTERNET SERVICE IS REQUIRED with at least 100Mbps download speed and 20+ Mbps upload speed.

• As part of this position requirement, you must have a computer that will be used exclusively for your work with us. This means we will be installing our security software on that computer, will remove admin rights from you, and monitor/ control it for security and compliance reasons. In return, we will pay you additional “rent” fees, on top of your salary, in the amount of several hundred dollars. Details about this “rental” will be discussed during your second interview. There are minimum requirements that your computer must have in order to be employed with us. You must have a Computer/Laptop with at least i5 minimum 9th gen processor (preferably a newer one) with 16 GB RAM or more, or Ryzen 5/7 (MUST include TPM support), as well as Windows 11 OS.

• You must have recently worked on a night shift for 2 consecutive years or more.

• We evaluate/ review employees monthly and provide consistent feedback.

• We offer raises and bonuses according to performance, certifications, attitude, and customer reviews twice/ year.

• Your manager (our IT director) will create a roadmap for your "KPIs" and certifications track. We always push our team to earn certifications and additional knowledge – even allowing “disconnect study time” during business hours!

• On-call rotation (after-hours) for a week at a time, once every 4-5 weeks. It's VERY rare that we get calls after-hours (the average is only twice/ year!).

• We're closed on major US holidays, and at the completion of the first 3 months of employment, you'll qualify for paid holidays.

• Work hours are Mon-Fri at 8 am till 5:30 pm (UTC-07:00 , MST, Arizona time zone)

• Every 4 to 5 weeks, you'll be working 1/2 day on a Saturday (project work/catch-up work) and get 1/2 day off the week after

• Mandatory 1-hour lunch and additional breaks (as you need those) throughout the day.

• Further details and information will be discussed with qualified candidates.



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:

• REQUIRED: Relevant minimum 3 YEARS of experience working for an MSP

• REQUIRED: With AT LEAST 2 years of experience in an L2 position, supervisory or lead role.

• REQUIRED: Microsoft Azure AD/ M365 experience

• REQUIRED: Experience working with an RMM and PSA software (DATTO preferred)

• Preferred: Cyber Security education/experience

• Preferred: Hyper-V experience



Other tools we use:

Barracuda DNS filter, AutoElevate, Cylance, Infocyte, Syxsense, IT Glue, SonicWall, Unifi, and more



HOW TO APPLY?



Send an
 to 
 with the subject line "L2 Tech Support - August 2026".



In your
 body, you MUST include the following, and ONLY the following, please:

- An attachment of your resume in PDF format (Please update your resume before submitting it, as we use an AI-powered agent to review qualifications.)

- A confirmation (simple written statement) that you have a 100% clean background with no criminal history.

- A confirmation (simple written statement) that you understand the business hours (MST\ Arizona time zone.



Answer the following questions:

1. How many years of experience do you have working in an MSP company? Name of the MSP company/s you worked with.

2. Do you have at least 2 years of experience in an L2 position, supervisory or lead role?

3. Do you have experience working with RMM and PSA software? What applications did you use?

4. Do you have experience working with Virtualization, servers, GPO, TCP/IP, hyper-v/vmware, conditional access, Intune, and Scripting such as PowerShell?

5. Have you recently worked on a night shift for 2 consecutive years or more? What time zone and when?

6. Are you okay with the computer requirements and the rental arrangement described in the job details?

7. Do you have an internet speed of at least 100Mbps download speed and 20+ upload speed?



- No other information/cover letter or attachments should be included, besides a simple salutation and signature if so desired.



NOTE: Please do NOT apply using other methods besides the above. Any applicants who reach out to us via phone, social media, or any method other than the instructions above will automatically be disqualified.

Only those who followed the above instructions will be contacted within 2 business days, with further instructions.





We're looking forward to having you join our family!

title: Short-Form Video Editor
description:
Short-Form Video Editor (Remote, Full-Time, Long-Term)



Company: Banner Mountain Media

Location: Remote

Role: Short-Form Video Editor

Commitment: Full-Time, Long-Term



About Us



Banner Mountain Media is a U.S.-based video production and marketing agency serving home-service businesses, real estate firms, and architecture studios. We shoot real footage in the field and turn it into short-form content and paid ad creative that gets results for clients.



Role Overview



You take raw footage and briefs from our team and turn them into scroll-stopping short-form content: Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts, and paid ad creative. You understand pacing, hooks, and what makes someone stop scrolling in the first two seconds, and you can execute fast and consistently without losing quality.



This role requires consistent availability, reliable performance, and a long-term commitment.



Responsibilities



Edit raw footage into finished short-form content: cutting, pacing, text overlays, sound design, and platform-specific formatting.



Follow creative briefs precisely, including hook direction, on-screen text, and CTA placement.



Turn around edits on a consistent schedule without sacrificing quality.



Flag when footage or a brief has a problem before it becomes a bigger issue.



Stay current on short-form trends (Reels, TikTok, Shorts) and bring ideas, not just execution.



Required Skills & Experience



A real portfolio you can show us with your application, not "available on request." Link it in your first message.



Hands-on short-form editing experience: Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, or similar.



Proficiency in Premiere Pro, CapCut, or similar professional editing software.



Understanding of pacing, hooks, and retention: you can explain why a cut works, not just make it.



Comfortable following detailed briefs and taking direction without losing your own editorial judgment.



Stable high-speed internet and full-time availability with US business-hours overlap.



Preferred (but not required)



Motion graphics or basic animation skills.



Experience editing for paid ads specifically (not just organic content).



AI editing tools (CapCut AI or similar) used to speed up your workflow.



Color grading or sound design beyond the basics.



What We Provide



Real footage from real client shoots, not stock content.



Consistent monthly workload and stable long-term projects.



Clear briefs and direct feedback from our creative team.



Direct communication with the founder and the rest of the team.



Competitive monthly compensation based on experience and performance.



How to Apply



Submit the following:



A link to your portfolio in your first message. Applications without a portfolio link will not be considered.



Your editing software and specific short-form experience (which platforms, how long).



One or two lines on an edit you're proud of and why it worked.



Your expected monthly full-time rate.



Your normal working hours and timezone, and confirmation you can commit full-time and long-term.

We are hiring an Inbound Real Estate Lead Follow-Up & Qualification Specialist to handle warm inbound homeowner leads from people actively searching online to sell their homes.



This role exists to filter, qualify, or disqualify leads before they ever reach our acquisition team.



This is not sales, not cold calling, and not persuasion.



If you are comfortable asking direct questions, enforcing clear criteria, and ending calls professionally when a lead is not a fit, this role may be right for you.

Ask direct questions about:



motivation



timeline



property condition



decision-maker status



price expectations



Apply qualification rules consistently



Disqualify early when criteria are not met (this is considered success)



Transfer only clean, well-qualified opportunities to acquisitions



Document outcomes clearly in the CRM



You are evaluated on decision quality and discipline, not call volume.



Work Schedule & Availability (Important)

4–5 hours work



2-hour break



4–5 hours work

Stay emotionally steady on calls



Document accurately and follow SOPs



Work well independently in a remote environment

What We Offer



100% remote role



Consistent warm inbound leads



Clear SOPs, scorecards, and expectations



Stable, long-term opportunity for the right fit



Professional, process-driven team environment

“When would you disqualify a seller who sounds friendly but does not meet your criteria?”

title: Property Accounting
description:
FIXED WORK SCHEDULE - REQUIRED

Monday to Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Pacific Time. This schedule is fixed and non-negotiable. Applicants must have at least two years of proven experience working these same days and hours in a prior role.



Who We Are

Reside Management is a progressive residential property management company based in Vancouver, B.C, Canada. We manage single-unit and multi-family properties across the Lower Mainland.



We are expanding our accounting support team and are looking for an experienced Virtual Accounting Assistant who wants a stable, long-term role and can contribute with accuracy from day one.



About the Role

This is a hands-on accounting position supporting the day-to-day and month-end financial operations of a residential property management portfolio. You will work closely with management, property managers, and the accounting team to maintain complete and accurate records in Buildium, QuickBooks, Google Sheets, and Microsoft Excel.



The successful candidate understands property management accounting, catches discrepancies before they become problems, follows written procedures carefully, and asks clear questions when information is incomplete.



Key Responsibilities

1. Maintain accurate tenant, owner, property, vendor, and general ledger records in Buildium.

2. Record and review rent, deposits, management fees, owner contributions, vendor charges, reimbursements, and other property transactions.

3. Process accounts payable and accounts receivable, including invoice review, coding, approval tracking, posting, and payment preparation.

4. Complete bank, credit card, trust, operating, and clearing-account reconciliations and promptly investigate discrepancies.

5. Review tenant ledgers, rent rolls, outstanding balances, unapplied funds, security deposits, and recurring charges for accuracy.

6. Prepare and review owner statements, monthly financial reports, supporting schedules, and month-end workpapers.

7. Maintain accurate records in QuickBooks Online and ensure entries agree with approved source documents and supporting systems.

8. Use Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel to reconcile data, track exceptions, analyze variances, and prepare clear management reports.

9. Support Canadian and B.C. property management accounting processes, including GST-related records and trust-account documentation, under the direction of authorized team members.

10. Organize invoices, receipts, statements, approvals, and audit support in accordance with the company filing system.

11. Identify missing documents, unusual balances, duplicate entries, and process gaps; escalate issues with a clear explanation and proposed next step.

12. Follow established procedures, complete assigned work by deadline, and communicate progress or blockers promptly.

Required Experience and Qualifications

13. Property management accounting: Minimum three years of hands-on accounting or bookkeeping experience in residential property management or real estate.

14. Canadian experience: At least two years of accounting experience with a Canadian property management company is required. Experience in British Columbia is strongly preferred.

15. Pacific Time schedule: At least two years in a prior position consistently working Monday to Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Pacific Time is required.

16. Buildium: Minimum two years of regular, hands-on experience. You must be able to navigate accounting workflows confidently and use the platform with limited training.

17. QuickBooks: Strong working experience with QuickBooks Online, including transaction entry, coding, reconciliations, and financial reporting.

18. Spreadsheets: Strong Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, filters, sorting, lookups, pivot tables, and reconciliation schedules.

19. Accounting knowledge: Practical understanding of accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger coding, bank reconciliations, tenant ledgers, deposits, owner statements, and month-end close.

20. Accuracy and judgment: Excellent numerical accuracy, attention to detail, and ability to recognize when information does not reconcile.

21. Communication: Strong written and spoken English, active listening skills, and the ability to follow instructions and document work clearly.

22. Work style: Reliable, organized, coachable, willing to learn, and able to manage priorities independently while remaining accountable to the team.

23. Remote setup: A quiet professional workspace, reliable high-speed internet, a dependable computer, and a practical backup plan for power or internet interruptions.

24. Confidentiality: Demonstrated discretion when handling banking information, owner statements, tenant records, and other confidential financial information.



What We Offer

- A stable, full-time, long-term remote position with a consistent schedule.

- The opportunity to work with an established Canadian property management company.

- Structured training, documented processes, and support from the accounting and operations teams.

- A collaborative, improvement-focused environment that values integrity, accountability, dependability, and initiative.



Application Process

Please submit:

- Your current resume.

- A short cover letter describing your property management accounting experience in Canada and your experience using Buildium and QuickBooks Online.

- Internet Speed report using https://www.speedtest.net/

- Picture of office set up 

- Please provide 2–3 professional references, preferably including a former manager or supervisor, along with their name, company, position/relationship to you, phone number, and
 address.



Applications with missing or unclear answers may not be reviewed.



Only candidates who meet the required experience and fixed Pacific Time schedule will be contacted.

title: Brand Partnerships & Growth Executive
description:
Brand Partnerships & Growth Executive



We are a growing UK-based Airbnb, serviced accommodation and hospitality company looking for a commercially minded Brand Partnerships & Growth Executive to help us build relationships, create new opportunities and develop additional revenue streams around our growing portfolio.



This isn’t a traditional sales or admin position.



We’re looking for someone who can look at every location we operate in and ask:



“Who should SOHA be connected with here?”



That could be a local business, gym, wellness provider, restaurant, coworking space, relocation company, employer or a larger brand that aligns with what we’re building.



What you’ll be responsible for



Your role will be to actively research, approach and build relationships with businesses and brands that could benefit both SOHA and our guests.



This could include:



* Researching businesses and brands around our accommodation locations

* Reaching out directly to potential partners

* Building relationships with wellness, fitness, recovery and lifestyle businesses

* Connecting with restaurants, cafés, coworking spaces and local experiences

* Developing relationships with companies and organisations operating near our properties

* Negotiating exclusive SOHA guest discounts and benefits

* Creating referral and commission partnerships

* Identifying new guest upsells and additional revenue opportunities

* Exploring collaborations and cross-promotional opportunities

* Helping develop packages and experiences around our stays

* Maintaining and developing relationships once partnerships are established

* Tracking the opportunities, value and revenue generated through partnerships

* Continually looking for new ways SOHA can increase the value of each guest stay



Who we’re looking for



We’re looking for someone who is naturally confident, commercially minded and good at building relationships.



You should be someone who sees an opportunity and thinks about how to make it happen.



Previous experience within business development, partnerships, sales, outreach, hospitality, travel, wellness or account management would be highly desirable.



You should have:



* Excellent written and spoken English

* Strong relationship-building skills

* Experience with outreach and approaching businesses

* Confidence negotiating mutually beneficial opportunities

* Strong research skills

* A creative and entrepreneurial mindset

* The ability to work independently

* Excellent organisation and follow-up

* An understanding that a great partnership should create value for both sides



What we’re building



SOHA isn’t being built to simply become another Airbnb management company.



Our long-term vision is centred around better hospitality, wellbeing and creating stays that offer guests more than simply somewhere to sleep.



We’re gradually building a network around our accommodation that can give guests access to better experiences, services and wellness opportunities while creating additional value for the businesses we partner with.



Over time, our ambition is to develop further into wellness-led accommodation, experiences and hospitality concepts.



This means the partnerships you create today could become part of something much bigger tomorrow.



The opportunity



This will initially be a part-time position, with the opportunity to grow alongside the company.



We are also open to creating a performance-based commission/incentive structure around partnerships and opportunities that directly generate additional revenue.



We want someone who is excited by the idea of not simply being given a list of tasks, but being trusted to find opportunities, make connections and help us grow.



To apply



Please tell us:



1. About your previous partnerships, business development, outreach or sales experience.

2. An example of a business relationship or partnership you’ve personally helped create.

3. How you would approach a business you’ve never spoken to before.

4. What types of businesses you think could add value to an Airbnb or serviced accommodation guest.

5. How you would turn a partnership into a revenue opportunity for both businesses.

6. Why working with a growing hospitality and wellness-focused brand appeals to you.



Please start your application with the words GROW TOGETHER so we know you’ve read the full advert.

Sometimes it’s a broken event, an incorrect UTM, or a product catalog having a bad day. You should be comfortable diagnosing all of it.

* Build, launch, manage, and optimize campaigns based on each client’s objectives

* Manage e-commerce and lead-generation accounts with varying budgets and levels of complexity

* Create thoughtful campaign structures that support testing, scaling, and accurate reporting

* Develop testing roadmaps for audiences, offers, messaging, formats, landing pages, and creative concepts

* Analyze performance beyond surface-level platform metrics to identify what is actually driving results

* Make strategic decisions about budget allocation, scaling, consolidation, and account structure

* Translate performance data into clear, actionable recommendations for clients and internal teams

* Collaborate with creative strategists, designers, editors, account managers, and other media buyers

* Provide clear creative feedback based on performance trends and audience behavior

* Conducting detailed pre-launch quality-control checks

* Documenting tracking setups, campaign structures, tests, and account changes

* Diagnosing technical issues instead of immediately assuming poor performance is a creative or audience problem



What We’re Looking For



* At least 3–5 years of hands-on paid social media buying experience

* Strong experience managing both Meta Ads and TikTok Ads

* Demonstrated success managing and scaling e-commerce campaigns

* Experience with lead-generation campaigns is a plus

* Strong knowledge of campaign architecture, testing methodology, attribution, and performance analysis

* Hands-on experience with pixels, conversion events, UTMs, product feeds, and server-side tracking

* Working knowledge of Shopify, Google Analytics 4, and Google Tag Manager

* Experience with attribution platforms such as Triple Whale is a plus

* Ability to distinguish between a creative problem, an offer problem, a landing-page problem, a tracking problem, and a media-buying problem

* Strong analytical skills and confidence working with large amounts of performance data

* Excellent attention to detail, particularly during setup and quality control

* Clear written and verbal communication skills

* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities

* A proactive, solution-oriented mindset

* Willingness to take ownership of both strategy and execution

* Reliable availability during U.S. business hours, with regular overlap during Pacific Time

## You’ll Be a Strong Fit If You



* Can explain not only what happened in an account, but why it happened and what should happen next

* Know when to follow platform best practices and when the data supports a different approach

* Enjoy developing strategy but do not consider tracking, naming conventions, documentation, or QA “someone else’s job”

* Can turn performance data into useful feedback for a creative team

* Catch small errors before they become expensive ones

* Communicate concerns early and arrive with potential solutions

* Are comfortable being accountable for results without pretending every outcome is fully within the ad platform

* Work well with a distributed, international team while maintaining consistent U.S. working hours



## What Success Looks Like



* Campaigns are launched accurately, on time, and without preventable tracking or setup errors

* Client budgets are managed responsibly and paced appropriately

* Testing is structured around clear hypotheses rather than random changes

* Performance insights lead to better creative, stronger landing pages, and smarter account decisions

* Reporting is accurate, meaningful, and connected to the client’s business goals

* Account issues are identified and resolved proactively

* Clients and internal team members understand what is working, what is not, and what we are doing next



## About Second Screen Digital



Second Screen Digital is a Los Angeles-based performance marketing agency supporting growing brands through paid media, creative strategy,
 marketing, SEO, and web design. Although our team works remotely, our clients and core operations are based in the United States. Team members in this role must maintain reliable availability during U.S. business hours and collaborate regularly with colleagues working in Pacific Time.

description:
Hi! We're looking for a talented Video Editor to join our fantastic team in the Philippines.



There are currently five people on the team based in the Philippines: three focused primarily on social media, a graphic designer, and a full-stack developer. We work hard, collaborate extremely well, and have a genuinely fun and supportive culture. We do great work, but we also believe in living great lives.



Now we want to add someone who can take our video content to the next level.



 ** What You'll Do **



We produce a lot of short-form video content for social media. Right now, the content is good, but the editing is pretty amateur. We want you to change that.



You'll help us:



 - Edit short-form social media videos

 - Improve pacing, cuts, captions, graphics, and transitions

 - Optimize audio and video quality

 - Develop a consistent, professional style for our videos

 - Collaborate with our graphic designer on branding and visual assets

 - Help us improve how we record content so it's easier to create great finished videos



In the future, we'll also be producing longer-form educational content and online courses that will require professional video editing and sound optimization.



 ** What We're Looking For  **



We're less concerned about which software you use and more concerned about whether you're really good at editing video. You should have a strong portfolio and experience with professional editing software such as Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or similar tools. Experience with Canva, Figma, iMovie, and Adobe Creative Cloud is a plus.



Most importantly, we're looking for someone who is creative, dependable, communicates well, takes pride in their work, and enjoys being part of a team.



 ** How We Work **



We're a remote team and primarily use Google Workspace, Google Chat, and Google Meet. We also use Canva extensively, while our design and development team works in Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud.



Although we work remotely, we also like spending time together in person. We typically organize two team retreats each year in the Philippines where we can work, brainstorm, eat, laugh, and have some fun together.



 ** The Opportunity **



We'd like you to start part-time, giving both you and us a chance to make sure we're a great fit for each other. If things go well, we anticipate this could become a full-time position beginning January 1, 2027. This isn't intended to be a short-term freelance gig. We're hoping to find someone who can become a long-term member of our team.



Full-time team members also receive 13th-month pay.



 ** How to Apply **



Please send:



 - A short introduction about yourself

 - A link to your portfolio

 - Your three best video examples, with a sentence explaining what you did on each

 - The editing software you prefer

 - Your current availability and desired hourly rate

 - A few sentences about why you'd like to join our team



Don't hesitate. If this sounds like something you'd enjoy, then reach out. And please don't send us a generic application. We're hiring a person, not a résumé. Let us see some of your personality.



We look forward to meeting you!

title: Project-Based Social Media Manager – Food Brand
description:

PROJECT SCOPE

title: Senior Technical Implementation VA / AI Automation Specialist
description:
Senior Technical Implementation VA / AIAutomation Specialist



About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Technical Implementation VA / AI Automation Specialist to serve as a

primary hands-on technical resource for ReThink/AIA.

This is a senior-level implementation role for someone who can take a real business problem, understand

the underlying requirements, design the appropriate technical solution, and independently build, test,

deploy, troubleshoot, and document it.

You should be comfortable speaking with business owners and executives, asking the right questions,

challenging unclear requirements, and translating business objectives into reliable automation and AI

systems.



This is not a task-based VA role. We are looking for someone who can operate as a technical solutions

partner with minimal supervision and eventually help ReThink build repeatable technical fulfillment systems

as the client base grows.



Compensation

Starting at $15/hour, with the intention to transition to a monthly retainer based on experience, technical

capability, and performance.



Key Responsibilities



Serve as the primary hands-on technical implementation resource for Kyler/ReThink.

Participate in client discovery calls when technical expertise is required.

Analyze business processes, workflows, data requirements, integrations, and desired outcomes to

properly scope projects.



Ask intelligent and detailed questions before recommending or building a solution.

Translate business problems into appropriate technical architecture, workflows, integrations, and

implementation plans.



Build and deploy AI agents, workflow automations, CRM systems, lead-management processes,

appointment-setting workflows, sales automation, dashboards, and related solutions.

Configure and integrate APIs, webhooks, third-party SaaS platforms, databases, CRM systems, and

automation tools.

Build and maintain solutions using platforms such as n8n, Make, Zapier, GoHighLevel, or

comparable technologies.



Determine where AI and automation should—and should not—be used within a business process.

Thoroughly test implementations before client deployment.



Diagnose and resolve broken automations, API failures, integration issues, data-flow problems, CRM

configuration issues, and edge cases.

Maintain and optimize deployed systems after launch.

Document technical architecture, workflows, access requirements, configurations, SOPs, and client

handoffs.



Communicate project status, blockers, dependencies, risks, and next steps clearly.

Work alongside with the team, and other fulfillment resources as required.

Identify when a requested solution is technically impractical, unnecessarily complex, or better solved

through an alternative approach.



Help establish reusable technical SOPs, templates, workflows, and fulfillment standards that can

improve implementation efficiency as ReThink grows.

Own implementations from discovery through scoping, build, testing, deployment,

documentation, and ongoing optimization.



Required Qualifications & Skills

Senior Technical Implementation Experience

Senior-level, hands-on experience building and implementing AI automation systems for real

businesses and end clients.

Proven ability to independently take ownership of technical projects from requirements gathering

through deployment.

Experience working directly with clients or stakeholders to understand business requirements and

translate them into technical solutions.



Automation & CRM

Strong working knowledge of:

CRM systems

Workflow automation

AI agents

API and webhook integrations

Lead capture and management

Appointment booking

Sales pipelines

 and SMS automation

Reporting and dashboards

Advanced proficiency with tools such as n8n, Make, Zapier, GoHighLevel, or comparable platforms.

Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies and AIA's existing technology stack.



AI & Technical Architecture

Strong understanding of LLM and AI-agent implementation.

Ability to determine when AI adds meaningful value and when a traditional automation or non-AI

solution is more appropriate.

Ability to design technical architecture based on the actual business requirement rather than simply

following predefined workflows.

Strong troubleshooting and debugging capabilities across automation platforms, APIs, CRMs,

integrations, and data flows.



Client Communication



Comfortable joining discovery and implementation calls with business owners, executives, and other

nontechnical stakeholders.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Strong business acumen and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to nontechnical clients.

Able to ask thoughtful questions, identify missing information, clarify requirements, and manage

expectations professionally.



Autonomy & Ownership



Highly autonomous and capable of working with minimal technical oversight.

Should not require detailed SOPs or step-by-step instructions for every assignment.

Able to identify dependencies, technical risks, access requirements, and potential blockers before

development begins.

Comfortable taking ownership when requirements are ambiguous and proactively determining the

next steps.

Strong documentation habits and attention to detail.



Preferred Qualifications

The following are highly valued but not required:

Experience working directly with AI automation agencies or consulting businesses.

Experience delivering automation solutions across multiple end-client environments.

Experience designing and deploying custom AI agents.

Experience with:

AI voice systems

Conversational AI

Inbound/outbound lead qualification

AI appointment setters

Sales automation

Familiarity with SaaS and white-label environments.

Experience working with agency CRM infrastructure.

Experience supporting both internal agency infrastructure and external client fulfillment.

Familiarity with OpenAI/LLM APIs, vector databases, RAG, structured prompting, and advanced

agentic workflows.

Previous experience as a Technical Solutions Consultant, Implementation Manager, Technical

Lead, or similar role, rather than exclusively working as a task-based VA.

Experience creating technical SOPs, reusable templates, and standardized fulfillment systems.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured by:



Technical projects delivered accurately and within agreed timelines.

Ability to independently move projects through discovery ? scope ? build ? test ? launch.

Minimal technical oversight required from Kyler or the AIA team.

Quality, reliability, and scalability of automations and AI solutions deployed.

Speed and accuracy when diagnosing and resolving technical issues.

Strong performance during client-facing discovery and implementation calls.

Ability to identify requirements and dependencies upfront, reducing rework.

Clear and proactive communication regarding project status, blockers, risks, dependencies, and next

steps.

Quality of technical documentation and client handoffs.

Development of reusable systems, templates, SOPs, and processes that improve fulfillment

efficiency.

Ability to identify better or simpler technical approaches when appropriate.



What Success Looks Like

You should be someone who can move beyond simply executing instructions and instead operate as a 

technical problem-solver and implementation partner.

As ReThink grows, there will also be an opportunity to help shape the company's technical fulfillment

infrastructure, standardize successful implementations, and create reusable systems that can be deployed

across multiple clients.



Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is:

Technically strong — can actually build, integrate, debug, and deploy.

Business-minded — understands the problem before jumping into the technology.

Client-ready — confident communicating with business owners and executives.

Autonomous — capable of figuring things out without constant direction.

Solution-oriented — knows that the best solution is not always the most complicated one.

Detail-oriented — tests thoroughly and documents what they build.

Proactive — identifies risks, dependencies, and potential improvements before they become

problems.

Adaptable — comfortable learning new tools and working across different client environments.



Role Type

Remote | Technical Implementation / AI Automation

Compensation: Starting at $15/hour, with potential transition to a monthly retainer based on experience

and demonstrated capability

title: Customer Support & Retention Specialist
description:
Type: Full time · Remote · Monday to Friday

Salary: $400 – $600 USD/month depending on experience, plus a bonus on every subscription you save from cancelling.



How to apply — read this first



Do not send a message here. Do not send a CV here.



Go to this link and complete the application:







Pick this role from the list. There is a field inside to upload your CV — that is where we want it. Applications sent any other way are ignored.



What the job is



We run subscription e-commerce brands. Every month, customers write in: where is my order, I want to pause, I want to cancel, I was charged twice. How those messages are answered d
 how much money the business makes.



That is this job. You are the only person our customers ever speak to. You keep them happy, you keep them subscribed, and you make sure we never ship a product to someone who has already disputed the charge.



Your work



1. Answer everything, every day. Every customer message gets a real answer, not a template that misses the point. You clear the inbox daily — no message sits unanswered overnight.



2. Handle chargebacks before they cost us twice. Check the chargeback and dispute reports. When a customer disputes a payment, flag them immediately so we do not ship them the product — otherwise we lose the money and the goods. You keep that list accurate, every single day.



3. Save the cancellations. When someone wants to cancel, that is not admin work — that is the moment the job actually happens. You find out why, you offer the right thing (pause, skip a month, a smaller plan, a discount inside our rules), and you keep the customer if keeping them makes sense. You are paid a bonus for every save. When someone genuinely wants out, you cancel it cleanly and politely — we do not trap people.



4. Process the routine work correctly. Cancellations, pauses, address changes, refunds, re-shipments. Following our rules exactly, every time.



5. Spot what keeps coming back. The same question five times a week means something is broken upstream — the product page, the shipping estimate, the billing
. You tell us, with the numbers. Fixing the cause beats answering the question a hundred times.



What we need from you

Written English that sounds warm and natural. You are the voice of the brand. Customers should feel like they are talking to a person who is on their side.

You stay calm with angry people. Some customers write in furious. You do not take it personally and you do not get defensive.

Extremely reliable. The inbox does not wait. If you skip days, this role is not for you.

Detail-oriented. Getting a chargeback flag wrong costs us the product and the money.

You follow rules exactly — what you can offer, what you cannot, and when to escalate.

Comfortable with Shopify, Gmail, Google Sheets, Slack.

You use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude) to work faster without sounding like a robot.

Nice to have



Experience with subscription businesses, retention or churn. Helpdesk tools (Gorgias, Zendesk, Front). Klaviyo. Any experience with chargebacks or payment disputes. Supplement or health brands.



Before you apply



Some of our brands are in health and women's wellness, including intimacy products. You will answer customer questions about them. The work is never explicit, but if that topic is not for you, this role is not for you and that is completely fine.



What we offer

A stable, long-term, full-time position.

A documented playbook. You are not inventing answers — the responses, the rules and the limits already exist.

A bonus tied to retention. Save subscriptions, earn more. Your incentives and ours are the same.

Direct work with the owner. No middle manager.

Paid trial first: we send you five real customer messages, including one cancellation and one chargeback. You write the replies you would send. Good trials get hired within days.

Paid on time, every time.



Again: the only way to apply is

title: Real Estate Disposition & Sales Operations Manager
description:
Job Description



We are a rapidly growing U.S. real-estate investment company looking for an exceptional full-time Real Estate Disposition & Sales Operations Manager.



This is not a traditional virtual assistant position. We are looking for someone who combines excellent sales ability with exceptional reliability, organization, ownership, and leadership potential.



Your initial responsibility will be helping manage properties after they are placed under contract. You will communicate with investors and buyers, market properties, negotiate offers, follow up with prospects, maintain our disposition pipeline, and help move transactions successfully toward closing.



Over time, the right person will take increasing ownership of our sales operation, participate in seller Zoom calls, negotiate directly with property owners, improve company systems and processes, train other team members, and potentially move into a management position.



Responsibilities include:



Communicating and negotiating with real-estate investors and buyers

Marketing properties to our buyer network

Following up consistently with prospective buyers

Negotiating purchase prices and terms

Conducting professional phone and Zoom conversations

Keeping every active deal organized inside our CRM

Making sure every deal has a clearly defined next action

Identifying potential problems before they become emergencies

Coordinating with our sales, operations, and transaction teams

Building and maintaining relationships with repeat buyers

Helping improve SOPs, systems, and workflows

Eventually conducting seller sales and negotiation calls

Eventually helping train and manage additional team members



The person we are looking for is extremely dependable.



If you accept responsibility for something, we should be able to trust that it will get done without constantly checking on you.



We want someone who is competitive and enjoys sales but is also disciplined enough to follow up every day, maintain accurate records, and perform consistently even when the work isn't exciting.



The ideal candidate is persuasive, confident, organized, proactive, coachable, competitive, comfortable with accountability, and interested in building a long-term career with our company.



U.S. real-estate acquisitions, wholesaling, dispositions, transaction coordination, investor relations, or high-ticket telephone sales experience is strongly preferred.



This is a long-term position with significant opportunities for increased compensation, responsibility, and management.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Social Media Manager (Remote, Full-Time, Long-Term)



Company: Banner Mountain Media

Location: Remote

Role: Social Media Manager

Commitment: Full-Time, Long-Term



About Us



Banner Mountain Media is a U.S.-based video production and marketing agency serving home-service businesses, real estate firms, and architecture studios. We build organic social content and paid creative that turns real production work into a consistent online presence for our clients.



Role Overview



This is a specialist role, not a side skill on an admin generalist's task list. You own organic social strategy and execution for several clients at once: what to post, why it works, and how it builds toward more leads and brand trust over time. You plan content calendars, write captions and hooks, build or brief graphics, and know the difference between content that gets views and content that moves a business forward.



This role requires consistent availability, reliable performance, and a long-term commitment.



Responsibilities



Own the content calendar and posting cadence for multiple client accounts across Instagram,
, and other relevant platforms.



Write captions, hooks, and copy that match each client's voice, not a generic template.



Build a full-funnel content mix: top-of-funnel awareness, middle-of-funnel trust-building, bottom-of-funnel conversion content.



Design or brief graphics and short-form video content using our in-house production assets.



Track what is working (engagement, reach, saves, follows) and adjust the plan based on real results, not guesswork.



Stay current on platform trends and adapt proven formats to each client's brand.



Report results on a clear schedule in plain numbers and plain language.



Required Skills & Experience



Social media management as your primary specialization, not one skill among many on a general VA task list.



A real portfolio of content you personally created: captions, graphics, or short-form video, with results if you have them.



Understanding of full-funnel content strategy (top, middle, bottom of funnel), not just "post daily."



Comfortable managing multiple client accounts at once without dropping the ball.



Clear written English and a consistent reporting habit.



Stable high-speed internet and full-time availability with US business-hours overlap.



Preferred (but not required)



GoHighLevel (GHL) or similar CRM experience.



Basic graphic design (Canva or similar) and short-form video editing (CapCut or similar).



Paid social experience (boosting or running ads directly).



Experience with AI content tools (ChatGPT, Canva AI, CapCut AI) used to speed up, not replace, your own judgment.



What We Provide



Real client accounts and real creative ownership, not busywork.
