title: Documentary Script Writer — Wildlife & Nature Storytelling (Human Writers Only)
description:
Company: Eterna Animal



---

Read this part first



Most people would scroll past a video about ants.



Then a guy in the Philippines spends thirty minutes talking about a 1,200-gallon glass box, and five million people find themselves emotionally invested in whether a colony of trap-jaw ants can hold their territory against carpenter ants. People cry over a colony collapse. In a tank. About bugs.



That is not luck, and it is not the footage. It is the writing.

That is the job we are hiring for.



Who we are



Eterna Animal is a wildlife and nature documentary studio built for YouTube and long-form streaming. We make films about animals, the people obsessed with them, and the moments where the two collide — the kind of stories that stick with someone for a week after they watch.



We are currently in production on a feature documentary about the 2011 Zanesville exotic animal escape, alongside an ongoing series slate and an expert interview segment.



We are small, we move fast, and the writing is the whole thing.



What you'll actually be doing



•⁠  ⁠Writing full documentary scripts, 10–30 minutes, from research to final narration draft

•⁠  ⁠Writing serialized episode scripts where arcs, callbacks, and running threads carry across a season

•⁠  ⁠Building cold opens that make someone stop scrolling in the first eight seconds — and earn the thirty minutes that follow

•⁠  ⁠Researching deep: papers, archives, news reports, court records, primary interviews. Not the first page of Google.

•⁠  ⁠Prepping interviews — background packs and question sets that get a real answer instead of a press release

•⁠  ⁠Writing voiceover that a human being can actually say out loud without sounding like a textbook

•⁠  ⁠Knowing when to stop writing and let the footage breathe



The one hard rule: you write it, not a machine



We have tried AI-written scripts. We are done with them.



The facts came out fine. The sentences were clean. And every single one was dead on arrival — no pulse, no stakes, no point of view, no reason to care. Viewers left at forty seconds, and honestly, we would have too.



Our audience needs to feel something. Awe. Dread. Grief. Delight. That comes from a person who noticed something and could not shut up about it — not from a model predicting the most average next word.



*Our policy, plainly:*



•⁠  ⁠Research tools, transcription, fact-checking, spell-check: fine. Use whatever helps.

•⁠  ⁠The actual prose, the structure, the voice, the emotional turns: yours. Typed by you. Thought of by you.

•⁠  ⁠We check. We ask you to explain your choices out loud. It's obvious very quickly.



If your process is "prompt it, then clean it up," this role will make both of us miserable. No hard feelings — please skip it.



What we're looking for



•⁠  ⁠A voice. We can teach you our format. We cannot teach you a personality on the page.

•⁠  Emotional honesty. You can make a stranger care about an animal they have never heard of and would have called ugly an hour ago.

•⁠  ⁠Structure instincts. Hook, promise, tension, complication, turn, payoff. You feel where a scene sags.

•⁠  Writing for the ear. Short sentences. Rhythm. Room to breathe. Read your draft aloud and you'll hear what's wrong.

•⁠  ⁠Genuine curiosity about animals. You don't need a biology degree. You do need to be the kind of person who has fallen down a three-hour rabbit hole about a species nobody asked you about.

•⁠  Strong conversational English. Warm and clear, not stiff and academic.

•⁠  ⁠Reliability. You hit deadlines, and you tell us early when you can't.



Nice to have (not required)



•⁠  ⁠Background in biology, zoology, veterinary science, or conservation

•⁠  ⁠Experience writing for YouTube specifically, and an understanding of retention and audience drop-off

•⁠  ⁠Experience with interview or investigative writing

•⁠  ⁠You already watch this kind of content for fun



What we're not looking for



•⁠  ⁠Blog writers pivoting to video with no ear for spoken language

•⁠  ⁠Anyone whose samples all read in the same smooth, weightless, listicle voice

•⁠  ⁠Writers who need a full brief spoon-fed before they can start

•⁠ ⁠"SEO content specialists"



How it works



1.⁠ Paid trial script. One episode, fully paid, real assignment, real feedback.

2.⁠ ⁠If it clicks: ongoing work with a steady script quota and a raise once you know the voice.

3.⁠ Long term: you become the lead writer on a series with your name on it. We want someone who grows into this, not someone who fills a slot.



---



How to apply — read carefully, this is the filter



Applications that skip any step get deleted unread. Sorry. It's the only way we find you.



Subject line: ⁠ COLD OPEN — [the animal you chose] ⁠



Send us all four of these:



1. The test. Write a 150–200 word cold open about *an animal you have personally seen, in real life, that most people would find boring.* A gecko on your wall. A carabao. A stray dog. A moth. Make us care about it. This is the entire job in 200 words.

2. A voice recording, 2 minutes. Vocaroo or Loom, unscripted. Tell us why you picked that animal, and one line in your own draft you would cut and why. Just talk. We are not judging your accent — we are listening for the same person who wrote the script.

3. Your best existing work. A script, a video you wrote, an essay, anything. Plus one sentence on what you would change about it now.

4. Share the test as a Google Doc (link with comment access) rather than pasted text. We look at version history.



Where to send: to this job posting

We read every application that follows the instructions. If your cold open is good, you will hear from us within a week.



---

Eterna Animal — wildlife documentaries for people who never bought that they were "just animals."

description:
We're a US-based video marketing agency producing cinematic short-form video ads for our clients.

We're busy, which means steady, ongoing work for the right person.



This starts as a part-time, per-video arrangement. If you're good and reliable, this grows.

---



WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING



Short-form vertical video ads (1-2 minutes), typically built around a script OR unscripted testimonials with b-roll and stock footage layered in. Clean, cinematic, and premium-looking content.



This is important:  What we're NOT looking for is an editor who relies on flashy transitions, flying text, and motion effects to carry a video. If your best work is built around those things, we're probably not the right fit. If your best work is built around making footage feel intentional and polished - we want to hear from you. What we care about is the fundamentals: pacing decisions, choosing the best takes, b-roll selection, color correction, and clean storytelling.



---



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We can teach technical skills. What's harder to find - and what we care about most - is two things:



1. Attention to detail and ability to learn from feedback. Before you send any edit, you've already watched it three times and caught every issue yourself. We understand mistakes happen, but we should never have to tell you something twice.



2. A good eye. Specifically when it comes to stock footage and b-roll. You know the difference between a clip that feels natural and cinematic versus one that looks awkward or like generic stock footage. 



---



PAY



We pay $75+ per video depending on length and complexity. Editors who deliver clean, revision-light work that we can approve quickly become invaluable. If you takes pride in getting it right before it ever lands in our inbox, there's room to earn more here.



REQUIREMENTS



— Adobe Premiere Pro 2025 / 2026 (required)

— The ability to edit at least 3-5 videos per week

— Fluent English, written and spoken

— Experience editing short-form testimonial videos, cinematic interview-style content, and lifestyle b-roll

— A computer capable of storing and handling 4K footage and graphics smoothly

— Strong communication and responsiveness - if we send a message, we expect a reply the same day

— Open-minded and willing to learn new systems and workflows



---



HOW TO APPLY



Do not just send your resume. We receive a lot of applications and we read every one - but here's how to make sure yours gets noticed:



Answer this question in your application: What is your favorite sport?



If you don't answer it, we won't move forward. It's a small thing, but it tells us you read carefully and follow instructions - which matters a lot in this role.



Also include:

- A short note about yourself and your editing experience

- Your portfolio

- 2–3 samples of your BEST work



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a short skills test before any paid work begins. It won't take long, but it's how we make sure we're a good fit for each other.



Looking forward to hearing from you.

title: Full-Stack Developer & Automation Engineer (Next.js, Supabase, Web Scraping & AI APIs)
description:
We are launching a highly automated, global city event discovery platform. The platform relies entirely on programmatic data pipelines—scraping events from high-authority, premium sources (museums, galleries, established ticket hubs), using LLM APIs to automatically categorize, tag, and score them, and rendering them on a custom, ultra-fast color-coded visual interface. 



We are looking for a highly capable, autonomous Full-Stack Developer & Automation Engineer to build, launch, optimize, and maintain this system. You will be the sole technical engine behind this platform, working directly with the founder to scale it from London across Europe and the USA.



Core Responsibilities:



1. Build & Maintain Scrapers: Design robust, automated scraping pipelines using Node.js, Puppeteer, or Playwright to ingest event listings from designated Tier-1 websites and APIs. 



2. AI Pipeline Integration: Connect scrapers to the Gemini API (Flash/Haiku) to clean raw text, extract parameters, assign primary color categories based on strict priority logic, generate short summaries, and produce confidence scores.



3. Develop Frontend UI: Build and maintain an ultra-fast, mobile-first, interactive visual calendar grid using Next.js (React) and Tailwind CSS. 



4. Programmatic SEO Optimization: Set up dynamic routing structures and ensure perfect, automated implementation of structured JSON-LD Event Schema on every listing page.



5. Database & Backend Architecture: Manage the PostgreSQL/Supabase database, configure automated cron jobs for data synchronization, and build a secure backend admin dashboard for anomaly verification.



6. Proactive System Monitoring: Monitor system health logs. If a source site changes its HTML structure and a scraper breaks, you must diagnose, patch, and rerun the pipeline autonomously.



Technical Requirements:



1. Frontend: Expert-level Next.js (React), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS. Highly focused on web performance and Core Web Vitals.



2. Backend & DB: Proficient with Node.js, PostgreSQL, and Supabase (including Edge Functions and cron triggers).



3. Data Ingestion: Confident writing script scrapers that successfully handle dynamic, JavaScript-heavy sites (Playwright/Puppeteer) and bypass basic security blocks.



4. AI Frameworks: Hands-on experience working with LLM APIs, handling structured JSON outputs, prompt engineering, and optimizing token consumption costs.



5. SEO: Strong understanding of technical SEO principles, programmatic page generation, and structured microdata (
).



Soft Skills:



1. High Autonomy: Ability to take a conceptual workflow layout and build out the system infrastructure with minimal daily supervision.



2. Systems Thinker: You prefer fixing a prompt's underlying instruction logic over manually editing a single broken database entry.Excellent 



3. English Communication: Clear documentation skills for codebases, system diagrams, and logging errors.



HOW TO APPLY (Mandatory Screening Questions): 



Applications that do not explicitly answer the following 3 questions in their cover letter will be archived automatically without review.



1. In 2–3 sentences, explain your preferred approach for configuring a Node.js script to pass raw scraped text to the Gemini Flash API and guarantee it safely returns a structured JSON object every time.



2. What is your experience with Programmatic SEO, and how do you handle dynamic JSON-LD Event Schema generation inside a Next.js App Router environment? 



3. Briefly describe the most complex automated web scraping project you have built. What tools did you use, and how did you handle dynamic content or structure changes on the target site?



Provide links to previous work, resume, and portfolio.



Thanks

/share/9cd974e7c8a848de8b84a4a992df4e45



About Veritas



Veritas builds complete Starlink Mini deployment setups: mounts, power, cables, cases, and accessories for consumers, work teams, and government fleets. We are a growing U.S. company with a small, high-output marketing team in the Philippines.



Role details

• Approximately 45-50 hours per week, fully aligned with Pacific Time.

• Philippine graveyard shift: roughly 11:00 PM to 8:00 AM or 12:00 AM to 9:00 AM, depending on U.S. daylight saving time.

• Occasional weekend availability when production, launches, or publishing require management coverage.

• You must live in Metro Manila, Rizal, Bulacan, Cavite, or Laguna. There are no regular onsite office days, but occasional in-person meetings may be scheduled.



What you'll own



At full production, the team aims to deliver one long-form video and up to 14 supporting assets each week for
, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and X.



PHASE 1: LEAD CREATIVE PRODUCTION



• Manage a two-person video-editing team, including their priorities, workload, deadlines, coverage, development, and performance.

• Turn approved priorities into clear production plans, briefs, scripts, storytelling direction, B-roll needs, and deliverables.

• Own the production pipeline: capacity, assignments, dependencies, revisions, blockers, asset readiness, and delivery visibility.

• Review short-form, long-form, ads, thumbnails, static assets, carousels, platform versions, and other creative output.

• Evaluate the full story—not only whether one shot matches one line. Check hooks, pacing, B-roll, demonstrations, captions, CTAs, factual accuracy, brand alignment, and viewer flow.

• Give editors clear, prioritized, actionable feedback and verify that required revisions were completed correctly.

• Use performance findings to identify stronger hooks, packaging, formats, V2/V3 opportunities, and creative tests.

• Build and improve SOPs, review standards, production trackers, asset repositories, AI-assisted QA, and backup coverage.

• Coordinate minor corrections and urgent production support when needed, without turning the role into a primary editing position.



PHASE 2: ADD SOCIAL MEDIA OPERATIONS



Phase 2 is planned to begin 60–90 days after your start date, once Phase 1 is operating reliably and you have demonstrated readiness for the expanded scope. At that point, you will also:

• Manage the current Social Media Moderator and future social media team members.

• Own the publishing calendar, content inventory, platform schedules, launch pushes, and publishing verification across
, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and X.

• Ensure each platform receives the correct version, copy, CTA, description, tags, products, related content, links, and native-platform setup.

• Oversee community, marketing inboxes, important comments and messages, channel presentation, and routine reputation handling.

• Manage routine creator-partnership and affiliate operations, including communication, records, deliverables, logistics, and escalation.

• Own routine UTM, Bitly, campaign-link, profile-link, and destination-verification workflows.

• Review social performance and turn findings into decisions, tests, and coordinated creative recommendations.

• Build and maintain the social department’s processes, AI workflows, reporting, and continuity systems.



The responsibilities above describe the core scope of the role but are not exhaustive. As Veritas grows, you may also take on related creative-production, social-media, team-management, and marketing-operations responsibilities that are reasonably aligned with the position and approved business priorities.



You're a strong fit if you



• Have at least eight years of professional work experience, including at least three years managing teams and at least two years inside a creative or marketing function.

• Have meaningful corporate, in-house, agency, or field-based operating experience, not only freelance, VA, or task-based remote experience.

• Have managed a creative or video-production pipeline and can lead workload, quality, deadlines, coaching, and accountability.

• Are exceptionally strong at storytelling and can evaluate the complete story and business goal, not only technical editing details.

• Act without waiting for step-by-step direction and continuously improve quality, speed, visibility, and continuity.

• Use performance evidence and AI to improve decisions and execution while checking sources and protecting brand and product accuracy.

• Communicate clearly in conversational American English.

• Can sustain the graveyard schedule and occasional weekend coverage.

• Have reliable primary internet, backup internet, and backup power.

• Want one company to grow with for the long term.



How to apply



Use this subject line and at least 20 AP:

[INSERT REQUIRED WORD] - [X] years of professional experience - [X] years managing teams



Include the following:

• Your resume with company names, employment dates, role titles, team sizes, and whether each role was corporate, in-house, agency, freelance, or VA work.

• Have you directly managed a creative-production or video-production team? Answer Yes or No. If yes, state the team size.

• In one short logistics block, confirm that this would be your only job and that you would complete all work personally. Include your city or province, most recent U.S.-hours role and actual schedule, primary and backup internet, backup power, and occasional weekend availability.

title: Full-time Bookkeeper
description:
Who We Are -



Hello; my name is Casandra Armstrong, and I am the President of Resilient Pro Group LLC. We are an accounting and tax firm based out of Phoenix, AZ (United States).



We are a small, but growing company and are experiencing quite a bit of growth. This has pushed the need for us to hire you, our newest team member.



We help small businesses, just like ours, maintain, manage, and grow their businesses by ensuring accurate financials, processing payroll for their employees, tax preparation and strategy. We ensure we can take as much off the owner’s plate as possible while building trust within our working relationships.



You’re probably wondering if you would be our first Filipino team member?



Actually, no. We currently have 4 team members who are from the Philippines like yourself. We have 2 bookkeeping specialists, a tax specialist, and an administrative specialist that are based in the Philippines as well. In addition to them, our operations manager is US based.



If you’re wondering what you would be doing?



The job title is Bookkeeping Specialist. I am looking for someone who can perform detailed bookkeeping for several small business clients. Your primary duties as a bookkeeper would include document processing, data entry, account reconciliation, ledger management, and financial report processing while understanding the business structure and needs. We are QuickBooks based, so a QuickBooks background is required. However, we will also train on processes.





So, why should you join us over anyone and everyone else?



If you would like…

1) a steady pay check with the chance for bonuses based on performance,

2) the opportunity to work from home without a boss breathing down your neck,

3) a team environment where you work with others to share the work, and

4 ) if you want to work for a stable, growing U.S. firm,

…then this is a job you will enjoy and excel at.





How to know if you’re qualified for this opportunity?



We are looking for someone who has bookkeeping experience, complete understanding of debits and credits, assets and liabilities, inter-company transfers, problem solving skills, fluent in English speaking and writing with the experience of speaking directly with US clients, and most importantly someone who can work with little to no direction and meet deadlines. We do not expect you to know it all as we will train you in your position with everything you need to know about our clients and our field for you to be able to excel at your job.



I do need you to be a good leader- someone who can effectively manage him or herself at the job as well as manage others; someone who has extensive attention to detail, can manage and meet deadlines, follow processes and provide ideas for enhanced processes, problem solve and troubleshoot on their own with little to no direction, be able to effectively resolve issues with upset clients. Intermediate bookkeeping/accounting experience, and QuickBooks experience is required.



I also cannot teach you to have a good attitude and to be self-motivated. These are things you must demonstrate in the interview process.



A successful applicant must be able to demonstrate:



* A can do attitude, and the ability to work without constant supervision

* Be able to speak in conversational English and write in passable English as well

* Knowledge of Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, Dropbox, QuickBooks, and general ability to use windows based software

* Have or be willing to obtain Internet fast enough to allow for virtual meeting such as zoom and VOIP phone calls without degradation

* Working microphone and Internet video camera

* Workstation with 2 monitors



So, what are the working hours?



As I stated before, our company is based in Phoenix, Arizona so we would require you to work during the US business hours, Monday to Friday 8:00am to 5:30pm Arizona Time



What about pay?



We are serious about hiring someone and are looking to fill this position ASAP. I also want this to be a real job that can meet your financial needs. Therefore, pay is negotiable but know I want you to be happy and satisfied working here, and a good pay scale is part of that.



What about the 13th Month?



Wondering if we pay the 13th month? Unfortunately, we do not. However, we do offer other benefits such as pay time off, holiday pay, and sick time for Full-Time positions. These benefits begin to accrue after your 90 days probation period of a full-time position.



What happens next?



Since our jobs are so popular we generally get deluged with applicants. So, I have designed a multi-part interview process to make the process as simple and efficient for all parties.



The first part of the interview process is designed to examine your English-speaking & writing skills, personality type, internet speed and ability to follow directions. Please realize the initial application process will take a time commitment on your part of roughly 10-20 minutes. Since this job is intended to be well paying, I hope this time commitment is acceptable to you. Please be advised that those who submit incomplete applications will be passed over.



If you make it through this first round, we will talk via video chat to answer any questions you may have as well as get to know you better. If this goes well, I will invite you to meet some other team members, as well as call your references to see if there is still a good fit.



We will then ultimately hire someone.





How to Apply



Therefore, to submit your application for the job, please complete all of the following and
 them to me at the reply to
 address: 
 Please send me all the following to applications at resilientpros dot com

a. Your resume

b. Link to your onlinejobs.ph profile and,

c. Names with your relationship for 3 people I can contact whom would say good things about working with you. This could be a priest, former employer, bank manager, school teacher, but no more than 1 of these people can be a family member.



2. Please also complete the tests at the following link and provide a copy of your results:


/leveltest/grammar_level_test.htm


/disc-personality-test/


/tools/speed-test/work-from-home-speed



Please be advised that incomplete applications will be ignored. I know this sounds harsh, but this is a detailed job, and I need to know you can follow directions.

title: Outbound Call Representative
description:
# Outbound Appointment Setter – HVAC | Excellent English Required



We are a growing U.S.-based HVAC company looking for a confident and reliable **Outbound Appointment Setter** to join our team.



Your primary responsibility will be calling homeowners from our provided lead lists, having natural conversations, identifying potential HVAC needs, and scheduling qualified appointments for our team to provide an HVAC estimate.



## MOST IMPORTANT REQUIREMENT: SPOKEN ENGLISH



**Excellent spoken English is required for this position.**



You must speak fluent, natural, easy-to-understand English with **clear, neutral pronunciation**.



You will be speaking directly with homeowners in the United States, so your ability to communicate clearly, naturally, and confidently over the phone is extremely important.



**A voice recording is REQUIRED with your application. Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.**



## What You'll Do



* Make outbound calls to homeowners using our provided lead lists

* Follow our calling script while still sounding natural and conversational

* Identify homeowners who may need HVAC replacement or service

* Ask qualifying questions

* Handle basic objections

* Schedule qualified appointments for HVAC estimates

* Accurately record call outcomes and appointment information

* Consistently work toward daily and weekly appointment goals

* Follow up with prospects when necessary



## What We're Looking For



* Excellent, fluent spoken English

* Clear, neutral, easy-to-understand pronunciation

* Confident and professional phone presence

* Previous outbound calling, telemarketing, call center, or appointment-setting experience

* Experience speaking with U.S. customers strongly preferred

* Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls

* Comfortable speaking with homeowners who were not expecting your call

* Able to follow scripts while still sounding conversational

* Good objection-handling skills

* Coachable and willing to improve

* Reliable and consistent

* Reliable high-speed internet

* Quality headset and quiet working environment

* Ability to work during U.S. business hours



HVAC or home-services experience is a plus but **not required**.



We can teach you HVAC. Strong English communication, confidence, reliability, and phone presence are the most important qualities we're looking for.



## Compensation



**Base Pay: $5 USD/hour**



PLUS:



**$10 USD for every appointment you schedule that results in a completed HVAC estimate.**



There is **no cap on appointment bonuses.**



The more qualified appointments you schedule that complete an estimate, the more you can earn.



### Example Earnings



At 40 hours per week:



* Base Pay: $200/week

* 10 completed estimates: +$100

* 20 completed estimates: +$200

* 30 completed estimates: +$300



**Important:** The $10 bonus is earned when the homeowner completes the scheduled HVAC estimate with our team — not simply when an appointment is placed on the calendar.



We care about **quality appointments, not just quantity.**



Strong performers will have opportunities for increased compensation and additional responsibility.



## Schedule



This position requires working during **U.S. business hours**.



You must be dependable and available consistently during your scheduled hours.



## HOW TO APPLY



Please send the following:



1. A brief summary of your outbound calling or appointment-setting experience.

2. How long you have worked with U.S.-based customers.

3. Your current internet speed and work setup.

4. **A 60–90 second voice recording.**



### Voice Recording Instructions



In your recording:



**First:** Introduce yourself and tell us briefly about your previous calling experience.



**Second:** Explain why you believe you would be good at speaking with U.S. homeowners.



**Third:** Pretend you are making an outbound call and read the following:



“Hi, this is [Your Name] calling with our local heating and air team. I know I'm calling you out of the blue, but we're reaching out to homeowners in your area regarding their heating and cooling systems. I just wanted to ask you a couple of quick questions and see if we might be able to help. How old would you say your current HVAC system is?”



We will evaluate your:



* Spoken English

* Pronunciation and clarity

* Confidence

* Conversational ability

* Phone presence

* Ability to sound natural rather than simply reading a script



**Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.**



We're looking for someone who wants a **long-term position**, is motivated by performance, and wants the opportunity to earn more as they produce results.

title: Video Editor & Social Campaigns - AI Start Up
description:
EchoVerse Collective - Video Editor & Social Campaigns



We build agents for humans. EchoVerse Collective is an AI-native media, content and intelligence company. Our flagship product is Dispatches - a personalised daily brief about AI, written by four AI columnists and approved by a named human editor before anything ships. You can read it at 
/dispatches. Alongside it we build document-automation and intelligence products for businesses. These are live products with real users, not prototypes.



We publish something worth watching every single day, and almost nobody sees it. We have no real presence on any social channel. That is the job.



THE WORK



Video editing is the centre of this role. Most of your week is in the timeline.



- Edit. Short-form vertical cuts from our daily articles and audio editions - the kind of thing that stops a thumb. Talking-head pieces from the founder. Product walkthroughs. Launch films. Subtitles, sound, pace, type, colour: all yours.

- Run the channels. Plan and schedule what goes out, write the copy that goes with it, and hold a posting rhythm we can actually sustain. LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram - we will start narrow and expand.

- Run paid campaigns. Build and manage paid social - audiences, creative variants, budgets, reporting. Tell us what the numbers say each week, including when the answer is that something is not working.

- Build the machine. Templates, presets, caption styles, a shot library, prompt libraries for the generative tools. Anything you make twice becomes a template. It is the only way one person keeps a daily channel fed without drowning.



You would be the only person doing this. Nothing you make passes through a committee or a three-week approval chain, because neither exists here. You make it, we look at it together, it ships. When it is wrong I will tell you that week, and then it is yours to fix, not mine to override.



We are an AI-native company and we mean it. Generative tools - video, image, voice, avatar - are part of the craft here, not a shortcut we tolerate. We cover every tool and every credit.



YOU WILL FIT IF



- You are genuinely strong in an editing suite - Premiere, DaVinci Resolve or After Effects. Not "I can cut a clip". You have opinions about pace, about where a cut lands, about how type and sound carry a piece that has no budget for a crew.

- You have made short-form video that performed, and you can tell us why it performed. A number is good. An explanation of the number is better.

- You have run paid social campaigns with real money behind them - you have built audiences, tested creative, read the reporting, and changed what you were doing because of it.

- You use generative tools well. You know which model to reach for and why, and you know when the output is not good enough to ship. If it looks like the AI made it, it does not ship.

- You can write. The copy that goes with the video is part of the job, and it is in English.

- You work well from short written briefs, you say plainly what is done versus in-progress versus not started, and you never report a result you did not verify.



Tell us if you have any of these: motion graphics and kinetic typography; podcast or audio-led editing; YouTube specifically (thumbnails, retention, the long form); ElevenLabs, HeyGen or similar avatar and voice tools; Veo, Kling, Runway or Flow; analytics beyond the platform dashboards;
 or newsletter growth.



YOU WILL NOT FIT IF



- You want a volume job. Forty ad variants a week, auto-captions, next one. We want four things a week that are right.

- You need a detailed brief and a locked storyboard before you can start.

- You describe your work by what you made rather than by what changed.

- You would ship a generative clip because it was fast, not because it was good.



DETAILS - POST TRIAL SUCCESSFUL - ONE CANDIDATE 



- PHP 45,000 to 70,000 per month, depending on experience. That is set deliberately above the domestic market for this work, because we are hiring one person, not three.

- Full-time, fully remote, Philippines. Independent contractor, monthly invoicing, 13th-month bonus.

- We are in London (GMT+1). We need three hours of overlap - your afternoon covers it. Around a launch, occasionally more. The rest of your week is yours to schedule; we count the work, not the hours.

- Every tool and every credit is paid by us, from week one: your editing suite, the generative video, image and voice models, design tools, ClickUp, Claude. So is a machine that actually renders.

- The package also includes private health cover for you and your family, a monthly family fund paid on top of salary with no receipts and no questions, protected learning time each week with a budget behind it, and paid leave we expect you to take. Base rises are reviewed at six and twelve months and go into your engagement letter as real numbers before you start. Every figure is on the table at offer stage.



HOW TO APPLY - two things, both required



1. Three pieces of your work. Links, not attachments. Three maximum - pick the ones closest to short-form social video, and give us one line each: what it was for, and what you were trying to make the viewer do.



2. One written answer. Go to 
/dispatches, read one article, and tell us the 30-second vertical video you would make from it: the opening three seconds, what is on screen, where the words come from, and what you would want someone to do after watching. Do not make the video. Just describe it. A few hundred words is plenty.



Applications missing either will not be read.



SUBJECT LINE



Dispatches video - [name]



where [name] is the columnist who covers markets and capital. It is on the site. The wrong subject line is filtered automatically.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



From everyone who applies we shortlist five to eight people. Those people get a real edit: we send you footage, audio and a one-line brief, and you cut a short vertical piece. A few hours of work.



We pay PHP 2,500 for that edit. Everyone who reaches that round is paid, on delivery, whether or not we hire you. It is not a competition prize and it is not conditional on us liking what you made. If we asked you for it, you are paid for it.



From there, two or three people do a 45-minute call - you walk us through your edit and how you would build a campaign around it. One person gets the job. The whole process takes under two weeks.

title: Remote Outbound Caller
description:
REMOTE OUTBOUND CALLER



Part-Time Independent Contractor



ABOUT US



Upkeep Standard is a family-owned residential cleaning company serving Northwest Chicagoland. We provide dependable biweekly and monthly home cleaning.



THE ROLE



We are looking for a friendly and reliable remote caller to speak with potential customers, learn whether they are interested in recurring home cleaning, and help qualified prospects take the next step.



This is a part-time position with the potential for ongoing work.



RESPONSIBILITIES



* Make outbound calls using a company-provided contact list

* Introduce Upkeep Standard in a friendly and professional way

* Ask a few questions to understand the customer’s needs

* Identify interest in biweekly or monthly cleaning

* Schedule qualified prospects for the next step

* Record call outcomes and notes accurately

* Follow the provided script and calling procedures

* Respect all requests not to be called again



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



* Previous outbound-calling or appointment-setting experience

* Clear and friendly spoken English

* Strong listening and communication skills

* Reliable attendance

* Comfortable receiving feedback and coaching

* Computer, headset, stable internet, and a quiet place to work

* Availability during agreed U.S. Central Time hours



Experience calling U.S. customers or working with a home-service business is helpful but not required.



HOW TO APPLY




 
 with the subject:



Outbound Caller Application – [Your Full Name]



Please include:



1. Your résumé

2. Your outbound-calling experience

3. Your availability in U.S. Central Time

4. Your desired hourly rate

5. Confirmation that you have a computer, headset, and stable internet



Please also send a short 45–60 second video that includes:



* Your name and location

* A brief description of your calling experience

* A natural reading of this sample introduction:



“Hi, this is [your name] calling on behalf of Upkeep Standard. We’re a local residential cleaning company serving Northwest Chicagoland. I’m reaching out to see if you are currently considering biweekly or monthly home cleaning.”



You may attach the video or send a working Google Drive, Dropbox, Loom, or unlisted YouTube link.



SELECTED APPLICANTS



Selected applicants will be invited to a short interview and role-play. Final candidates may complete a brief paid trial before the position is offered.



COMPENSATION



Hourly contractor pay based on experience, with the possibility of performance bonuses.

title: Part-Time Production Graphic  Designer & Client Support Assistant
description:
We are a U.S.-based branding and marketing agency looking for a dependable, skilled production designer and client support assistant for a long-term, part-time position.



This role supports both our marketing agency and a growing network of multi-location businesses in North America. Our ideal candidate is comfortable creating professionally designed marketing materials, following established brand standards, handling routine support requests, updating existing website pages, and completing assigned production work independently.



Schedule and Pay:



$8/hour

Up to 20 hours/week

Up to 4 hours per day, Monday–Friday 



The workload varies. Some weeks include several quick support or production requests. Other weeks may include larger assignments requiring several focused hours over multiple days, with a reasonable deadline based on the scope of the project. We expect regular, meaningful progress throughout scheduled work periods.



Primary Responsibilities



Monitor and respond to routine client support requests.

Create flyers, signs, social media graphics, menus, promotional materials, and other branded collateral.

Edit and adapt existing designs for various locations, events, or promotions.

Follow established brand guidelines and existing visual styles.

Make basic WordPress website updates, including text changes, image updates, alt tags, and other entry-level website tasks.

Upload and format website content and images.

Resize, crop, organize, name, and export design files correctly.

Complete routine marketing, spreadsheet, and administrative production tasks.

Communicate clearly when instructions are unclear or additional information is needed.

Keep assigned work organized and provide a brief daily progress update.



Support requests are always the first priority. When support volume is light, remaining work time may be used for assigned design, website, marketing, and administrative projects.



Required Skills



Strong Canva skills (critical to this role).

Good understanding of typography, spacing, alignment, visual hierarchy, and layout.

Experience creating polished, publication-ready promotional flyers and marketing materials.

Strong written and spoken English.

Strong attention to detail.

Ability to follow detailed instructions and meet established brand standards and requirements.

Ability to remain focused on longer assignments.

Dependable Monday-through-Friday availability for up to four hours per day.

Reliable internet connection and computer.





Preferred Skills:



Canva

Adobe Illustrator.

Adobe Photoshop.

WordPress, front-end text and image updates.

Basic HTML or Bootstrap familiarity is a plus.

Experience supporting a marketing agency is preferred.

Experience working with franchises or multi-location businesses is preferred.

Experience handling customer or internal support requests is preferred.



This is not a senior brand strategist or creative director role. We are looking for someone with a good design eye who can reliably execute ongoing professional work within an established brand system.





A successful person in this role:



Reads the complete assignment before beginning.

Produces thoughtful, polished work rather than submitting the first rough draft.

Notices missing information or conflicting instructions.

Asks useful questions when needed.

Maintains organized and editable source files.

Checks spelling, dates, times, sizes, and required details.

Communicates well regarding scheduling, turnaround times, and challenges encountered.

Completes meaningful work during scheduled work periods.

Can move between support, design, website, and production tasks as needed.





How to Apply / Please include:



A portfolio is absolutely required and must contain at least three examples of flyers, brochures, menus, posters, social graphics, or other promotional materials you personally created.

A brief explanation of your role in creating those pieces.

Your experience using Canva, Illustrator, Photoshop, and WordPress.

Your current work schedule and whether you have other active clients or employers.

Confirmation that you are available for up to four hours per day, Monday through Friday.

Why a part-time role like this is the right fit for you.



Please do not submit only logo designs or illustration work. We specifically want to see promotional layouts, event flyers, marketing collateral, or production design work to be considered.



The selected candidate will begin with a 90-day evaluation period. Work will be assigned based on current business needs and paid at $8 USD per hour, up to 20 hours per week. Continued assignments will depend on performance, reliability, workload, and ongoing business needs.



An independent contractor agreement will be provided for review in advance of starting work.



The contractor is responsible for providing their own computer, reliable internet access, Canva access, and any other tools needed to perform the assigned work.



***We expect portfolios will contain the use of AI. We heavily favor works that demonstrate real design skill, strong knowledge of typography, and proper spacing. The person in this role will be expected to design from a blank canvas just the same. Simply generating things with AI is not at all qualifying for this role.***

title: Amazon Online Arbitrage Product Sourcer (Ebay To Amazon) (E2A)
description:
The Role

You will be responsible for sourcing profitable product leads from eBay and evaluating them for resale on Amazon. This includes working through a provided product list, reaching out to eBay sellers to gather additional information, and negotiating pricing down to our target buy price. You will also be expected to independently aggregate and validate new product leads on an ongoing basis.



Your Responsibilities

Research and evaluate eBay listings for Amazon resale potential

Contact eBay sellers to gather product details and negotiate pricing to target buy prices

Aggregate and submit new product leads using our internal tracking system

Validate leads against profitability thresholds using tools such as Keepa and SellerAmp

Maintain accurate records in Google Sheets throughout the sourcing process



Requirements

Fluent English — both written and spoken

Reliable computer, webcam, microphone, and stable internet connection

1+ year of experience as a Virtual Assistant

1+ year of hands-on Keepa experience (ability to read BSR history, price trends, and offer count changes)

Experience with SellerAmp (SAS) for profitability analysis

Solid understanding of ROI, profit margin, and Amazon sales rank

Online arbitrage sourcing experience — eBay sourcing experience is a strong plus

Comfortable working within Google Drive, Sheets, and Docs

Available for 40 hours per week



What We Provide

Full video training for every task in the role

Written SOPs with step-by-step instructions for each process

Access to required software and accounts (including sourcing tools)

Flexible scheduling — we will work with your availability to set a consistent calendar



Compensation:



5 USD per hour 



How to Apply

To be considered for this position, you must answer all of the following questions in order within your application. Incomplete responses will not be reviewed.



What experience do you have with the eBay marketplace? Be specific about how you have used it in a professional or sourcing context. Please do not provide generic answers. Give brands and actual examples of products you have sourced.



What tools have you used for Amazon product research (e.g., Keepa, SellerAmp, Replencatcher, Sellerboard)? For each tool, explain in depth how you used it and what you were evaluating.



Walk me through your exact process for determining whether a product is profitable. Include every cost you factor in.

Are you familiar with the eBay-to-Amazon reselling model? Walk me through how you understand the process from start to finish.



How do you verify that an eBay listing and an Amazon listing are for the exact same product? What steps do you take to confirm a correct match? Please give past examples of brands and products that you have sourced in the past.



What is your favorite animal? Put the name of your favorite animal as the subject line of the entire job offer response.



Describe what your daily sourcing workflow looks like. Please do not give generic answers. Give me exact tools and a step by step procedure that you followed.



Please attach a link to your resume. Make sure the link is publicly accessible before submitting.



What is the earliest date you would be able to start?

title: Amazon PPC Specialist — Growth & TACOS
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a hands-on Amazon PPC Specialist to improve advertising efficiency, total sales, organic visibility, and sustainable TACOS across our Amazon accounts.



Key Responsibilities

-Manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, and product-targeting campaigns across automatic, manual, ranking, branded, competitor, category, and ASIN strategies.

-Optimize campaign structures, budgets, bids, placements, bidding strategies, and testing based on performance, profitability, inventory, and product objectives.

-Conduct keyword and competitor research; harvest validated keywords and ASINs; manage negatives; and prevent duplication or irrelevant targeting.

-Analyze PPC and organic performance using Amazon Ads reports, Business Reports, Search Query Performance, placement data, and Helium 10.

-Evaluate CTR, CPC, CVR, ACOS, ROAS, TACOS, total sales, organic contribution, keyword rankings, and performance by campaign, target, search term, and placement.

-Identify advertising, conversion, listing, pricing, review, inventory, delivery, and competitive factors affecting results and recommend appropriate actions.

-Create, process, and troubleshoot Amazon Ads bulk files, with manual implementation when necessary.

-Use AI to improve analysis, research, reporting, bulk operations, and quality control while verifying outputs against source data.

Monitor changes and provide concise reports covering results, actions, opportunities, and next steps.



Performance Expectations

Performance will be measured through ACOS, ROAS, TACOS, total and organic sales, keyword rankings, conversion, CPC efficiency, and reduced wasted spend.

Higher ACOS must support a clear, time-bound objective—such as a launch or ranking initiative—and demonstrate measurable progress. When non-PPC factors affect results, the specialist must identify their impact, recommend action, adjust PPC appropriately, and monitor performance.



Requirements

Proven hands-on Amazon PPC experience across keyword, product, ranking, competitor, category, and placement strategies.

Strong understanding of PPC metrics and their relationship with total sales and organic growth.

Experience with Amazon advertising reports, bulk files, Search Query Performance, and Helium 10 or comparable tools.

Strong analytical judgment, attention to detail, independence, and ability to produce implementable recommendations.

AI proficiency and strong English communication skills are significant advantages.

Experience with supplements, health products, or other policy-sensitive categories is preferred.



Application Requirements

Please provide:

A summary of the Amazon PPC accounts you have managed.

An example of improving ACOS or TACOS while maintaining or increasing sales.

An example of PPC supporting organic ranking or sales growth.

Your experience with bulk files, Helium 10, Search Query Performance, and AI-assisted PPC workflows.

title: QuickBooks Certified Ecommerce Bookkeeper Needed for 2 Small US LLCs -
description:
We run two US LLCs and we want one person to own the books for both.



Both are small - roughly $100,000 in annual sales each - so the volume is modest. What we need is accuracy and consistency.



YUM CREATIVE LLC - digital content production

Budget: $80/month

Food photography and video production, around $100k/year. 3-4 bank and card accounts. Client invoicing and receivables, contractor payments, software subscriptions, equipment and shoot costs. Straightforward books, low transaction volume.



JARGANIC LLC - ecommerce - $150/month

Around $100k/year, but this is the demanding one. Accrual basis. Physical product inventory. 2 bank accounts and these sales channels:

- Amazon

- Walmart

- Etsy

- Shopify

- Mirakl (Lowe's and JC Penney)



TOTAL: $230/month for both entities.





WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO EACH MONTH



Both entities:

- Categorise and reconcile every bank and card account

- Close the month/quarter and deliver a full set of financial statements - P&L, balance sheet, cash flow - by an agreed date each quarter

- Keep the chart of accounts tidy and consistent so the numbers stay comparable month over month

- Maintain the fixed asset register and depreciation schedules

- Flag anything that looks wrong before we have to ask



Jarganic specifically:

- Marketplace settlement accounting done properly - gross sales, refunds, referral fees, fulfilment fees, storage, advertising and reserve movements all broken out. The bank deposit is not revenue.

- Inventory and COGS, with in-transit, FBA/WFS and 3PL stock tracked separately

- Mirakl (Lowe's, JC Penney) has no off-the-shelf QuickBooks connector, but we may be able to connect via Shopify - you'll build and post those settlement journals from the remittance reports

- Sales tax awareness (not filling yet): marketplace facilitator channels versus our direct Shopify sales

- Correct month-end cutoff on settlement periods that straddle the month boundary



ONCE A YEAR: THE TAX-READY PACKAGE. INCLUDED IN THE FEE.



For each entity you deliver:

- Final adjusted trial balance and year-end financial statements

- Bank and credit card reconciliations tied out through 31 December

- Inventory rollforward for Jarganic, agreed to the year-end count, with the landed-cost basis documented

- Fixed asset roll: additions, disposals and the book depreciation schedule

- AR and AP aging, loan and related-party balances

- A schedule of transactions between each company and its non-US owner, since both are foreign-owned LLCs and those have to be reported.



In other words: a clean, documented package a tax preparer can work from without coming back to us with questions.



What is NOT included, because it needs a credential and carries filing liability: converting the book numbers to tax basis (MACRS, Section 179 and bonus depreciation elections), and preparing and signing the returns themselves. If you hold the credentials below, we will pay you separately for that.





THE PART THAT MATTERS MOST TO US



We are not looking for a data-entry service. We are looking for someone who thinks and remembers.



Concretely, that means:



1. You propose, you don't just ask. When something unfamiliar hits the feed, you come back with "I've coded this to X because Y - confirm or correct," not "what is this?"



2. You ask once. Every recurring transaction gets a bank rule and a line in a written treatment log we can both see. We should never be asked about the same vendor twice.







REQUIREMENTS



Must have:

- Active QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification. Send the link to your public Find-a-ProAdvisor profile. Intuit only publishes profiles for advisors with current, valid certification, so that link is how we verify. A screenshot of a badge is not enough.



- Hands-on ecommerce bookkeeping experience: marketplace settlements, inventory, COGS



- Accrual accounting, not cash basis



- Fluent written and spoken English





BIG PLUS: US TAX CREDENTIALS



We do not need a US-based accountant and we are not looking for a US firm's pricing. We need someone who is credentialed to prepare US federal returns, and we do not care where you sit. Philippines, India, anywhere - if you hold one of these, say so clearly and we will treat your application as a priority:



- IRS Enrolled Agent (EA). 

- US CPA licence. Give us your licence number and the state that issued it.

- Active PTIN. Required for anyone we pay to prepare our federal returns. If you hold an EA or a CPA you will already have one - tell us your status either way.



If you hold any of these, we will engage you separately to prepare and file the US returns for one of the companies. That is paid work on top of the monthly bookkeeping fee.





OUR SETUP



We hold and pay for the QuickBooks Online subscription. We will connect the bank feeds and the sales channel integrations so the mechanical work is automated as far as it can be. 





SCOPE AND MONEY, STATED PLAINLY



- $80/month - Yum Creative LLC

- $150/month - Jarganic LLC

- $230/month - total for both, ongoing



Not included in the monthly fee, quoted separately:

- Initial setup, catch-up, or clean-up of historical books

- Annual US tax return preparation (credentialed preparers only  EA, CPA, PTIN, or AFSP)





HOW TO APPLY



Applications that skip these go straight in the bin.



1. Your Find-a-ProAdvisor profile link (with matching details).



2. If you hold an EA, a US CPA license, a PTIN, or an AFSP record, list them with the numbers so we can verify them.



3. What is your experience with e-commerce bookkeeping, inventory tracking, and accrual accounting?





We read every application properly. We reply to the ones that answer the questions.

title: Senior Accountant – Australian Taxation Experience Essential
description:
Senior Accountant – Australian Taxation Experience Essential



Full-Time | Work From Home | 40 Hours Per Week | Long-Term Position



We are a small Australian accounting practice providing taxation and accounting services to a broad range of clients. Our services include financial statements, income tax returns, tax planning, BAS preparation and bookkeeping.



We are seeking an experienced accountant to join our team in an important **long-term role within the practice**.



We are looking for someone who wants to become a key member of our team, grow with the business and build a long-term working relationship with the practice.



IMPORTANT – PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



Australian taxation experience is essential for this position.



Please do not apply if you do not have practical experience preparing Australian financial statements and Australian income tax returns.



You must also have strong professional written and spoken English, as the role involves communication with clients and other team members by telephone,
 and online meetings.



We are specifically looking for an accountant who already has the technical accounting and taxation knowledge required for the role and does not require training in fundamental accounting or Australian taxation concepts.



To confirm that you have read this advertisement carefully, please include your favourite number or numbers at the very top of your reply/application.  If they are not added, we will disregard the application.



Applications that do not demonstrate Australian taxation experience will not be considered.



Key Responsibilities



The role will include:



* Preparation of financial statements and income tax returns for:



  * Companies

  * Trusts

  * Individuals

* Preparation and review of BAS and other taxation work

* Tax planning and general taxation assistance

* Reviewing work prepared by other staff

* Providing constructive feedback and guidance to other team members

* Communicating with clients when required

* Assisting with the continued development and growth of the practice



Experience with **SMSFs is highly regarded but is not essential.



Australian Taxation Knowledge



The successful applicant should have a practical understanding and application of Australian taxation concepts, including:



* Division 7A

* Depreciation and capital allowances

* Family Trust Elections (FTE)

* Trust distributions and taxation

* Capital Gains Tax (CGT)

* GST and BAS preparation

* Company taxation and franking accounts

* Carried-forward tax losses and loss recoupment rules

* Personal Services Income (PSI)

* Small business concessions

* Motor vehicle and business-use deductions

* Superannuation contributions and taxation basics

* Tax planning for companies, trusts and individuals

* Preparation and reconciliation of tax-effect accounting entries where required

* General understanding of ATO compliance requirements and Australian tax legislation



Software



Experience with the following software would be ideal:



* Xero

* Xero Practice Manager (XPM)

* BGL Simple Fund 360 for SMSFs



However, experience with these particular programs is not essential** if you have strong Australian accounting and taxation knowledge.



Software training can be provided where required.



We will also provide ongoing training and professional development to help you continue building your knowledge, keep up to date with changes in Australian taxation and improve your skills within the role.



Salary & Benefits



Annual remuneration: PHP 1,600,000 to PHP 1,800,000 depending on experience, including 13th-month pay.



The higher end of the salary range is intended for candidates who have strong Australian taxation knowledge, can work with minimal supervision, review other staff members' work, communicate confidently with clients and contribute at a senior level within the practice.



The package includes:



*13th-month pay

*4 weeks paid annual leave

*5 days paid sick leave

* Full-time work-from-home arrangement

* Computer and relevant technology supplied by the practice

*Ongoing training and professional development

* Long-term career opportunity within a growing accounting practice



We are looking for someone who values the security and stability of a long-term position** and wants to develop with the practice over the coming years.



Working Arrangements



This is a full-time work-from-home position of approximately 40 hours per week



We can offer flexibility regarding the days and hours worked, provided the working arrangements are agreed in advance, an appropriate and consistent schedule is maintained, and work is completed within required deadlines.



The successful applicant must:



* Work consistent and agreed hours

* Be contactable and able to answer telephone calls during agreed working hours

* Have a professional and distraction-free home working environment

* Be reliable and able to work independently

* Manage their workload and meet deadlines without constant supervision

* Be organised and responsive during working hours

* Be committed to the position and interested in working with the practice for the long term



A computer and the relevant technology required to perform the role will be supplied.



The Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who:



* Has strong practical experience in Australian taxation and accounting

* Can prepare financial statements and tax returns with minimal supervision

* Does not require training in core accounting or Australian taxation skills

* Can identify taxation and accounting issues rather than simply process information

* Has strong attention to detail

* Is comfortable reviewing the work of other staff

* Can provide guidance and constructive feedback to team members

* Has excellent written and spoken English

* Is comfortable communicating with clients and staff by telephone

* Has a professional and distraction-free environment when working from home

* Is reliable and accountable while working remotely

* Has a strong work ethic

* Is self-motivated and able to work independently

* Is motivated to assist with the growth of the business

* Is willing to continue learning and developing professionally

* Is looking for a stable, **long-term position

* Wants to become an important and valued member of a small accounting practice over the long term



Minimum Requirements



Please only apply if you meet both of the following requirements:



1. You have practical Australian taxation experience, including preparation of Australian financial statements and income tax returns.



2. You have strong professional written and spoken English and are comfortable communicating with clients and team members by telephone.**



This role is suited to an experienced accountant who enjoys the flexibility of working from home but also understands the responsibility, consistency and communication required in a full-time professional position.



We are not looking for someone seeking a short-term or temporary role. We are looking for the right person to become an important part of our practice and remain with us for the long term.



If you do not have Australian taxation experience or strong professional English communication skills, please do not apply.**

title: Shopify Website Optimization Specialist (Luxury Fashion Brand) Project Overview
description:
Shopify Website Optimization Specialist (Luxury Fashion Brand)

Project Overview



FMB Apparel is a premium streetwear and athleisure brand built around loyalty, family, and elevated everyday essentials.



Important: I am not looking to rebuild my website from scratch or change my brand identity. My website is already established, and I am happy with its overall direction.



I am looking for an experienced Shopify expert who can refine, improve, and elevate my existing website into a more polished, luxury shopping experience.



The goal is to make the site feel as premium, clean, and effortless as the world's leading minimalist fashion brands while maintaining FMB Apparel's unique identity and story.



This project is focused on improvements, optimization, and attention to detail, not creating a completely new website.



About My Brand



FMB Apparel is the primary brand and represents premium streetwear and everyday luxury.



Within FMB Apparel is Day1 Collective, our sister brand dedicated to premium performance apparel. Day1 Collective is a "store within a store"—it shares the same Shopify website but serves a different purpose and customer.



FMB Apparel = Premium streetwear and elevated everyday essentials.

Day1 Collective = Premium performance apparel designed for training, running, the gym, and an active lifestyle.



One of the goals of this project is to improve how these two brands coexist within one website. Customers should clearly understand the difference between the two brands while enjoying a seamless shopping experience. The navigation should make it easy to move between FMB Apparel and Day1 Collective without confusion.



Scope of Work



I am looking for someone who can evaluate my existing Shopify store and recommend improvements that will enhance:



Overall visual presentation

User experience (UX)

Navigation

Mobile responsiveness

Product pages

Homepage layout

Collection organization

Customer shopping journey

Conversion rate optimization

Website speed

Brand consistency

The integration and presentation of both FMB Apparel and Day1 Collective



I want every page to feel intentional, clean, modern, and premium.



Specific Improvements

Homepage

Refine the current homepage instead of replacing it.

Improve visual hierarchy.

Enhance spacing and layout.

Create a stronger luxury feel.

Improve brand storytelling.

Better showcase both FMB Apparel and Day1 Collective while maintaining clear brand distinction.

Improve calls-to-action.

Make the homepage more engaging without making it cluttered.

Navigation

Simplify menus where appropriate.

Improve customer flow.

Make products easier to find.

Create a clear shopping experience for both brands.

Ensure customers immediately understand the difference between FMB Apparel and Day1 Collective.

Product Pages

Improve page layout.

Enhance image presentation.

Improve product descriptions and formatting.

Create a more premium shopping experience.

Add helpful trust-building elements where appropriate.

Overall Design

Improve typography.

Improve spacing and alignment.

Create better visual consistency.

Refine colors and button styles.

Maintain a clean, minimalist aesthetic.

Ensure every page feels cohesive.

Mobile Experience

Review every page on mobile.

Improve responsiveness.

Make shopping easy on all screen sizes.

Improve loading speed where possible.

Design Direction



The website should communicate:



Luxury

Minimalism

Premium quality

Editorial fashion

Modern simplicity

Confidence

Clean architecture

High-end shopping experience



The objective is to create a timeless luxury shopping experience inspired by the best in premium fashion while remaining uniquely FMB Apparel and Day1 Collective.



What I Am NOT Looking For

A complete website rebuild.

A new brand identity.

A new logo.

A new color palette.

A different overall aesthetic.

A generic Shopify template.



Instead, I want someone who can recognize what is already working and elevate it through thoughtful refinements and professional design improvements.



Deliverables

A comprehensive audit of my current website.

A prioritized list of recommended improvements.

Implementation of approved enhancements.

Improved homepage and collection pages.

Better navigation and shopping flow.

Enhanced product pages.

Clear integration of both FMB Apparel and Day1 Collective.

Mobile optimization.

Performance improvements.

Final testing and quality assurance.

Required Skills

Expert Shopify experience

Shopify 2.0

Liquid

HTML/CSS

JavaScript

UX/UI Design

Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)

Luxury Fashion E-commerce

Responsive Web Design

Performance Optimization

Please Include With Your Proposal



Before submitting a proposal, please review my current website at 
. I am looking for thoughtful recommendations—not a generic proposal.



Please include:



A brief audit of my current website.

Three to five specific improvements you would make.

Examples of Shopify stores you have improved (not just built).

Before-and-after examples of optimization work.

Estimated timeline.

Estimated project cost.

Why you are the right fit for this project.

Success Looks Like



When customers visit FMB Apparel, they should immediately recognize they are shopping with a premium fashion brand. The website should feel sophisticated, easy to navigate, visually consistent, and effortless to shop.



Customers should also immediately understand that Day1 Collective is FMB Apparel's premium performance division—a store within a store—without feeling like they have left the website.



The objective is to elevate and perfect my existing website—not replace it.

title: Video Editor
description:
We're Hiring: Video Editor  – Fully Remote

Location: PH

___________________________________________________

Hi! I’m Lawrence, founder of JazzUpCo - one of the fastest-growing home brands in the US, redefining how people experience modern dining and everyday elegance.



Our vision is simple: when people think of beautifully designed, high-quality flatware and homeware (with household appliances on the way), they think JazzUpCo. We’ve already served over 100,000 customers and are now building a global, design-first homeware brand.



We’re looking for a fast-paced, detail-oriented Video Editor to join us on an initial 6-month contract (with potential to convert to permanent) as we ramp up our creative volume for Q4 and beyond!



In this role, you’ll be a core creative engine behind our video marketing, turning raw product footage, UGC, and brand assets into high-converting social ads, polished short-form videos, and engaging campaign content. If you have a sharp eye for pacing, love visual storytelling, and want to help scale a design-first brand, we’d love to see your portfolio!

- Maintain brand consistency across all social channels.

- Manage content calendars and ensure content is delivered on schedule.

___________________________________________________

You’re a Fit If You Have:

- Proficiency with editing tools: Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects. (Knowledge of CapCut, Canva, Blender 3D or similar is a plus)



- Excellent attention to detail.



- Creative mindset with a strong understanding of audience engagement.

- PC requirements: 

    (i) Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 5700X / Intel Core i
, i
K, or higher

title: Customer Success Manager for Fast-Growing Collectibles Platform (Full Ownership, AI-Powered Support)
description:
Gotya (
) is the home of online pack ripping: users buy a digital pack, rip it live, and pull a real, professionally graded trading card that ships to their door or sells back instantly for 90% of its live market value.



Real cards, real money, real collectors. That means support is not a side desk here, it is part of the product.



We're hiring a Customer Success Manager who takes full responsibility for support and customer success. One goal drives this role: every Gotya user feels heard. Fast answers, real help, and reviews that prove it.



*What you'll own

- The inbox and SLAs: ensuring every question is answered quickly and effectively across
 and social media

- Our AI support agent: it drafts and answers alongside the human team, while you manage its knowledge base, quality, and escalation rules

- Reporting: tracking and categorising every question we receive and turning the insights into a weekly report the company acts on

- The team: hiring, training, and leading support agents as we scale

- Priority support for our most active collectors

- The review loop: creating happy users who feel heard, measured honestly through customer feedback and reviews



*How we measure success

- First response time, resolution time, customer satisfaction, and review scores. One question sits behind all of them: how well are our users being helped?



*You have

- 2+ years of experience leading customer support or customer success, including managing people

- Reporting experience that changed a process, not just described it

- Hands-on experience using AI in customer support—this is a hard requirement

- Excellent written English

- Full-time availability for a remote role

(Bonus: you understand Pokémon or the wider TCG world)



*To apply

Start your proposal with the word GEMMINT so we know you read the full vacancy. Then briefly answer the following questions:



- Describe your relevant experience for this role.

- Describe one support operation you owned from end to end.

- What measurable results did you achieve in that operation?

- Describe one concrete way you have used AI to improve customer support.

- What is your expected monthly rate?

- What is your earliest possible start date?

- Short and sharp beats long and polished.
